recipes.name: Allspice Dressing
recipes.author: Coach Jodi and Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Great as a dressing, dip, or sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 cup water, as desired for consistency.
instructions: Mix together the tahini, vinegar, mustard, and allspice. Add water as needed to reach the desired consistency.
The dressing will thicken when refrigerated.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Almond Balsamic Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty and nutritious vinaigrette dressing. Great for green salads and over top of vegetables.
ingredients: 1 cup water, as desired for consistency.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a high speed blender. Blend until smooth and creamy, approx. 3-5 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Almond Oat Cookies with Fruit Filling (No Oven Needed!)
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fortunately, you can eat these cookies raw - so long lines will be forming to the kitchen if not the oven. Covered in coconut and filled with natural fruit preserve, these cookies are the healthy version of macaroons.
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups unsweetened non-dairy milk, more if needed.
100% all-fruit preserves, or organic berry jam, no sugar added.
instructions: Grind oats slightly in a high-powered food processor or blender.
Mix ground oats with dates, soy milk, almond butter, and coconut until it forms a dough. Add more soy milk if needed.
Form into balls and roll into the coconut. Press down in middle with thumb and place a small amount (.5 oz per cookie) of 100% fruit spread in the indentation.
Refrigerate before eating.
Yields approximately 55 cookies.
recipes.notes: Special occasion dessert.
recipes.prepInstructions: Best served cold.
recipes.storageInstructions: Keep refrigerated / Does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Almond Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Sauteed mushrooms filled with onions, spinach, garlic, almond butter and seasoned with black pepper and thyme.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, or to taste.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
In a large pan, heat 2-3 tablespoons of vegetable stock with lemon juice and sauté chopped onion for 2 minutes.
Add chopped mushroom stems, garlic and thyme and continue to sauté until onions and mushrooms are tender, about 3 minutes.
Add mushroom caps to pan, along with vegetable broth, bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Best cooked covered.
Remove mushroom caps from pan and place on a baking sheet.
Add spinach to onion mixture remaining in pan and heat until wilted. Remove from heat and stir in almond butter, nutritional yeast, and black pepper.
Fill mushroom caps with spinach/onion mixture and bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve with cherry tomatoes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Almost Chocolate Cheesecake
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy pie that eats like a cheesecake, hold the food coma.
ingredients: 1 1/2 packages soft tofu, drained and squeezed.
1/2 cup natural cocoa powder, not dutch processed.
instructions: For crust: preheat oven to 350 degrees. Blend oats, walnuts, and dates in a high speed food processor until fine. Press into pie tin. Bake for 10 minutes until set firm.
Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
In a food processor, mash the yams and tofu together. One at a time, add the banana, date sugar, vanilla, and cocoa powder.
Pour into pie crust/pie dish, and bake for 55-60 minutes or until firm.
Cool and chill overnight.
Serve with a dollop of Creamy Cashew Topping.
For creamy cashew topping: Place raw cashew nuts, vanilla soy milk, vanilla, and dates into high powered blender and process until very smooth and thick.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Apple Cider Sage Vinaigrette
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Apple and sage, the perfect combination to make a delicious treat on your salad!
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a high speed blender until finely blended.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Apple Delight
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Perfect for that sweet tooth that needs satisfying! A melange of baked apples, walnuts, and raisins, with just the right amount of cinnamon to bring it home.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Combine all ingredients except the orange juice. Place in a baking pan and drizzle the orange juice on top.
Cover and bake at 375 degrees for about one hour until all ingredients are soft, stirring occasionally.
recipes.prepInstructions: Enjoy hot or cold! Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Smoothie
recipes.author: Isabel Pereira
recipes.description: Try this sweet apple pie smoothie for a healthy dessert option you and your family will love!
instructions: Blend with desired amount of ice cubes until combined.

recipes.name: Apricot and Garlic Glazed Turkey Breast
recipes.author: Robin Jeep, Healthy Food Now Coach
recipes.description: Organic, lean turkey breast with fresh sage, thyme, and a garlic-apricot preserve.
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb turkey breast, skin removed (4 ounces per person).
1/2 cup apricot no sugar spreadable 100% fruit.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In baking pan arrange apples, oranges, and onion close together. Lay herbs on top of fruit. Place turkey breast on top of fruit, onion, and herb mixture.
Mix apricot spread, no salt seasoning, liquid aminos, and garlic. Generously spread sauce on turkey.
Cover loosely with foil and bake for 30-35 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Arugula and Orange Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A collection of fresh vegetables and fruits that come alive with any of our dressings!
instructions: In a small sauce pan, put in the rice vinegar and lemon juice. Bring to a boil. Turn off heat.
Add sliced red onion. Let sit 30 minutes or until cool. Drain.
For toasted pine nuts: in 325 degree oven, lay nuts on cookie sheet. Toast in oven for 10-12 minutes. Be careful not to burn.
Put arugula and greens in salad bowl.
Top salad with the cherry tomatoes, cucumber, fennel, and red onion.
Garnish top of salad with mandarin oranges and lightly toasted pine nuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Asian Chicken with Broccoli
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy blend of chicken, broccoli, and mushrooms.
ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, skinless, cubed, 4 oz per person.
2 lb fresh broccoli, stems and florets.
1 cup carrot, cut into 1/4 inch rounds.
1 cup organic corn, fresh or frozen.
1 cup red bell pepper, seeded and coarsely chopped.
instructions: Place chicken in small steamer and steam for 25 minutes, then dice into small chunks.
Cut florets and stems into pieces.
Steam broccoli and carrots in a big pot for 15 minutes.
Add the water chestnuts, corn, mushrooms, and chopped peppers and steam for 5 more minutes.
Mix the sesame oil with the date sugar, arrowroot, pineapple with juice, and liquid aminos. Simmer on low heat for 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the chicken.
Add chicken mixture to vegetables and toss.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Asparagus, Beet and Dill Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty asparagus, beets, and red onion over romaine lettuce makes for a sweet salad with some bite.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Wrap scrubbed beets in foil and bake about an hour, until fork tender. Cool, peel, and slice.

Break tough stems off asparagus. This can be done by holding the asparagus near the tip and towards the end and bend it until it breaks where the stem gets tough. Cut asparagus into 1"1/2" inch diagonal pieces. Steam asparagus until crisp tender.
Rinse white beans.
Layer greens in bowl. Add beans, asparagus, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and beets.
Top with walnuts, black pepper, and one of our delicious dressings.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Avocado Cucumber Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy blend of avocado, dates, and pine nuts.
ingredients: 2 cups cucumber, peeled, seeded, and cut in pieces.
instructions: Blend all the ingredients in high speed blender until smooth and creamy.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato & Tofu Falafel
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: A healthy twist on a classic ethnic sandwich. I highly recommend checking out my other hummus recipes - the always classic Healthy Hummus and Red Pepper Hummus really complete this recipe!
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 450 F.
Fill a saucepan with an inch of water and boil it to created a steamer. Peel and chop the sweet potato into 1-inch cubes and place in a steamer basket over the boiling water.

Place a pan on low-heat and lightly spray with non-stick spray. Chop the onion and garlic, and mix them in a bowl with cumin and curry-powder. Cook for 5 minutes until onions become translucent. If the onions begin to dry out, add 2 tablespoons of water, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Transfer cooked mixture to a food processor and add the sweet potatoes. Pulse until onions are finely chopped.
Rinse the tofu and place it on a power towel. Place a paper towel on top of the tofu and push down to get the water out. Finely chop the tofu into crumbles.
In a big mixing bowl put the sweet potato mixture, tofu, brown rice, scallions, parsley, and ground pepper and mix.

Lay out a sheet of tin foil on a baking tray and lightly spray. Form a small handful of the mixture into 1 1/2 - 2 inch balls (depending on the size of falafel you like). Place in the oven at 450 F for 25 minutes.

You can serve this up a few different ways. The first way is as a platter - rinse and chop romaine, cucumbers, tomatoes, and carrots, and serve them with the falafel, some whole-wheat pita (best served warm - I like to throw them in the oven for 1 minute after the falafel are done cooking). Also, it's a MUST to serve this with one of my healthy hummus, to get the full experience!

You can also make a sandwich - the most fun way in my opinion. Spread the hummus on a warm pita, place the falafel, and top with the chopped veggies. Enjoy it then or wrap it in tin-foil for on-the-go consumption. Bring this baby to work and instant status boost, guaranteed.

recipes.name: Banana and Blueberry Chia Pudding
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A delicious breakfast pudding with fresh bananas and blueberries to start the day right.
ingredients: 4 cups unsweetened soy, hemp, or almond milk.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk non-dairy milk, chia seeds, rolled oats, vanilla extract, and raisins together.
Place banana slices at the bottom of each of bowl (preferably ramekin).

Pour the milk mixture over the banana slices and tap it down to make sure the bananas are completely covered by the non-dairy milk mixture so the banana slices will not be exposed to air and will not oxidize (turn brown).
Push the blueberries down into the non-dairy milk mixture, being careful not to create any air pockets.
Cover with plastic wrap and allow to sit for at least ten minutes or refrigerated over night. Serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Banana Colada Smoothie
recipes.author: Isabel Pereira
recipes.description: Tastes like a vacation in a glass!
instructions: Add all the ingredients to your blender along with 8-10 ice cubes and blend until frosty and thick.
Note: 1-2 Tbsp hemp seed can be added if desired (not included in the nutritional facts).

recipes.name: Banana Sweetened Microwave Oatmeal
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: A healthy but sweet treat for breakfast.
ingredients: 4 cups rolled oats (1/2 cup per serving).
4 cups mashed banana, ripe, peeled and sliced.
instructions: Place ingredients in a microwavable bowl.
Microwave on medium-high for 3 minutes.
recipes.notes: Apple juice may be substituted with water or both can be used.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 3 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Basil Mint Salad Dressing
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: A refreshing salad dressing made from cucumber, fresh mint, and basil leaves.
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, peeled, seeded and chopped.
instructions: Combine the salad dressing ingredients together in a blender until smooth and creamy.
recipes.notes: This dressing goes well with the Shades of Green Salad.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Bean and Kale Pico de Gallo
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Savory Portobello mushrooms and kale topped with a nutrient-rich, citrus flavored pico de gallo.
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, tough stems removed, chopped and divided.
1 large red bell pepper, seeded and diced.
1 pepper, large orange bell pepper, seeded and diced.
1 pepper, large yellow bell pepper, seeded and diced.
1/2 jalapeno pepper, diced or to taste.
3 tbsp, whole ground flax seeds, divided.
1 1/2 cup or red kidney beans, cooked.
instructions: To make pico de gallo, finely chop 1 cup of the kale and combine with tomatoes, onion, cucumber, bell peppers, celery, jalapeno pepper, clementines,and cilantro.
Process lime juice, balsamic vinegar, and no salt seasoning,
Take 2 tablespoons of the sesame seeds, walnuts and flax seeds and process in a food processor or high powered blender. Mix nut and seed mixture with 1 cup of the pico de gallo mixture and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine beans and heat, adding a small amount of water if necessary, to prevent from sticking.
Steam kale and mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes.

To serve, place half of the kale and mushrooms on a serving platter, layer with half of the beans and half of the pico de gallo. Repeat layers and top with remaining sesame seeds, walnuts and flax seeds.
recipes.notes: Serve the kale and Portobello mushrooms hot, top with chilled pico de gallo.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave kale and mushrooms for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed. Top with chilled pico de gallo.

recipes.name: Berry Banana
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: Refreshing way to start the day with a blast of berry that'll make you merry!
instructions: Put everything in your blender (a high-power one works the best) and blend until smooth.
Drink 1-2 servings until you're satisfied, and congratulate yourself on a great start to your day!

recipes.name: Berry Medley Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Blueberries, raspberries, cherries, and blackberries make a delicious combination!
ingredients: 12 oz frozen berries (blueberries, blackberries, raspberries, and cherries recommended).
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Best Brownies Ever with Cashew Cream Icing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Be careful with these brownies, you might think your fridge is broken but it’s just holding a moment of silence.
ingredients: 1 cup unsifted, dipped whole wheat pastry flour.
10 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, non alkalized.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine all dry ingredients in large mixing bowl and set aside.
In a high speed food processor or blender, put spinach and all wet ingredients (except egg whites) and puree until smooth.
For the last two minutes in food processor, add egg whites (do not over beat whites in processor).
Mix wet ingredients with dry ingredients (do not over mix).
Place in a cake pan (or half sheet pan) and bake 40 minutes (or until toothpick comes out clean).
To make icing, put all ingredients in food processor and blend well.
recipes.notes: Special occasion dessert. Non-vegan.
recipes.prepInstructions: Served chilled.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Veggie Soup
recipes.author: Isabel Pereira
recipes.description: A very fast and easy soup that doesn't skimp on flavour! Using canned beans and tomatoes shortens your prep and cooking time.
instructions: Chop the cabbage, onion, carrots and garlic. Add them to a pot along with the corn and 2 oz. water and water saute the vegetables until they are soft.
Puree two cups of the cooked black beans with the tomatoes.
Add the puree and the rest of the ingredients into the pot and simmer until everything is combined and the flavours have a chance to meld.
Note - The recipe calls for 2 cups of uncooked black beans. If you don't have time to soak and cook the beans ahead of time use two cans of beans instead.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Butternut Squash Chili
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: It's hard to believe that this one's healthy. A crowd pleaser and the kids love it, be sure to serve it cautiously at dinner parties, lest your guests stage a sit-in from the kitchen.
ingredients: 3 cups peeled butternut squash, 1/2 inch dice.
2 cups loosely packed kale, finely chopped.
1/4 cup, chopped green onion, for garnish.
instructions: Water saute the onions and garlic in vegetable stock until they are very soft and start to stick to the pan.
Add some more stock, the carrots, and celery. Saute, stirring until all the liquid has evaporated and the vegetables start to stick to the pan.
Add the spices and stir.
Add the tomato paste and stir. Cook for 5 minutes until the tomato paste starts to turn orange.
Add the diced tomato and scrape the tomato paste off the bottom of the pan. Stir together and bring to a simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining vegetable stock, no-salt seasoning, cooked beans, and butternut squash and bring to a simmer, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes until the squash is cooked through.
Stir in the kale. Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the nutritional yeast until well combined, then stir in the corn.
Serve the stew with a sprinkle of chopped green onion as garnish.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Mushroom Burger
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy burger made of mushrooms, black beans, shallots, and raw cashews.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Mash beans in a large bowl.
Blend the onion, mushrooms, cashews, vinegar, and paprika in a food processor or high powered blender.
Combine blended mix with beans and rice and form 8 patties.
Heat a non-stick pan (or a pan rubbed with a small amount of olive oil), flatten patties, and cook 8-10 minutes on each side.
Serve in pita with lettuce, tomato, and red onion.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave burger for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Quinoa Chili
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: This is a hardy chili, that stands alone thanks to the quinoa. I survived through college without overdosing on sodium at Chipotle thanks to this recipe, and it continues to be a go-to for cooking on Sundays for the entire week - it'll last a week in the fridge for one and a half weeks, no lie (you can come after me in the comments if it doesn't last)! Enjoy and let me know what you think in the comments below :)
instructions: Lightly cook ("sweat") the onions, garlic and jalapeno on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring every minute to be sure they don't stick.
Put everything EXCEPT the mushrooms in the pot with the onions, garlic and jalapeno and bring to a simmer. Stir every 5 minutes.
After letting simmer for 20 minutes, put the mushrooms in for the last 20 minutes (this way they're juicer at the end).

Let sit for 10 minutes, then enjoy! You can serve over long grain brown rice if you want a heartier meal. Cold, sliced avocado, fresh chopped cilantro and/or a low sodium organic salsa work beautifully on top, especially when cold. Don't forget some fresh squeezed lime!

recipes.name: Black Bean and Yam Quesadilla
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Black beans, yams, and red bell pepper meet with paprika, chili powder, and cumin in a fresh whole wheat tortilla for your own Mexican revolution on a plate.
ingredients: 2 tbsp no-salt-added vegetable stock, more if needed.
2 red bell peppers, cut into strips for garnish.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable stock in a skillet and saute the yam, carrots, onion, and spices for about 5 minutes (until tender).
Add the black beans and simmer on a low heat for another 5 minutes.
Add the kale and simmer for another 10 minutes (or until greens are cooked).
Put salsa ingredients in blender or food processor. Blend until chunky, according to preference.
Put veggie mixture onto tortillas, sprinkle with grated non-dairy Daiya Cheese, and fold them over.
Very lightly coat a non-stick pan with olive oil and toast tortilla to a light brown.
Serve salsa in a small souffle cup.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Black Cherry Vinaigrette
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Tasty, all natural black cherry vinaigrette dressing.
instructions: Add all ingredients to high speed blender and blend until smooth.
recipes.notes: Black Cherry Vinaigrette goes great on top of the Roasted Beet and Asparagus Salad.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Blueberry Delight
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Sweet blueberries, dates, and walnuts, seasoned with cinnamon and nutmeg. Simple and delicious.
ingredients: 2 cups blueberries, fresh organic or frozen.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Combine all ingredients.
Cover and bake for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all ingredients are soft.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve chilled or warm. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Bok Choy and Beans
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Oh boy, it's bok choy plus some adzuki beans with dill and lemon juice.
ingredients: 2 cups black rice, cooked, 1/4 cup per person.
2 packages (10 oz) pinto beans, drained and rinsed, no salt.
2 cups adzuki bean, drained and rinsed, no salt.
1 cup, pitted prune, soaked in water (just to cover) for at least 1 hour, cut into small pieces.
1/2 cup toasted pine nut, lightly toasted.
instructions: Before starting: soak prunes in water for at least one hour, before cutting into small pieces.
Cook rice according to package instructions.
Saute carrots and red pepper with dill and lemon juice until tender.
Then add beans, bok choy, and prunes and saute for about 4-5 minutes.
Serve with rice and garnish with toasted pine nuts.
recipes.notes: Slivered almonds are a possible substitute for pine nuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Broccoli Rabe
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Broccoli rabe sauteed in garlic and oregano, with onion and roasted red peppers.
instructions: In pan, add vegetable stock and bring to a boil.
Add onion and garlic and saute for 2-3 minutes.
Add broccoli rabe and cook 20-25 minutes (add more stock if needed) until broccoli rabe is tender.
Turn off heat and mix in roasted red peppers and oregano.
Taste for your desired flavor (broccoli rabe is bitter and the longer you cook it, the less bitter it becomes).
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Broccoli-Coleslaw
recipes.author: Heatlhy Food Now
recipes.description: This isn't your average slaw. It's sweet and tangy, and a great way to health up your meal.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Toss gently until all ingredients are combined.
Best to marinate for at least 2 hours.
Served chilled.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.
recipes.storageInstructions: Keep Refrigerated / Does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Brussels Sprouts Gone Crazy
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Brussels sprouts leaves with butternut squash and dried currants.
ingredients: 2 lb Brussels sprouts, cut in half.
instructions: Remove stem from Brussels sprouts, split in half, check for bad leaves, and clean.

Place cleaned half Brussels sprouts in pan with sliced shallots, vinegar, lemon zest, black pepper, and vegetable stock. Cook approximately 10 minutes, until Brussels sprouts are tender (do not overcook).
Add fresh thyme (no stems), butternut squash, currants, and hemp seeds and simmer for 5 minutes (add more stock if needed).
Remove from heat and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Brussels Sprouts in Chickpea Glaze
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tender Brussels sprouts served with a creamy, garlic and garbanzo sauce.
ingredients: 6 cups Brussels sprouts, de-stemmed and cut in half.
instructions: Clean, remove stems, and cut Brussels sprouts in half.
In sauté pan, add 1/4 cup vegetable stock and bring to boil.
Add Brussels sprouts and heat on medium temperature approximately for 10 minutes or until tender (do not overcook). Remove from heat when finished.
While Brussels sprouts cook, in a food processor combine garbanzo beans, vegetable broth, and seasoning and puree until it is a smooth sauce.
Pour sauce over Brussels sprouts and stir well to coat the Brussels sprouts.
Best served warm.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Bubba's Vegetable Gumbo
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Medley of fresh veggies in a hearty broth, seasoned with basil, red pepper, smoked paprika, and lemon.
ingredients: 2 cups collard greens, frozen, coarsely chopped.
instructions: Saute green and red peppers, onion, celery, and garlic until tender (approximately 5 minutes).
Add zucchini, diced tomatoes, and kidney beans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add oregano, basil, red pepper flakes, smoked paprika, and lemon juice and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add okra, collard greens, and vegetable broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Butternut Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A beautiful balance of flavor with butternut squash, ginger, and cinnamon.
instructions: Saute the onion in one cup of vegetable stock until very soft and all the liquid has evaporated.
Add the spices and stir to combine.
Add the remaining stock, butternut squash, and thyme and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Turn down the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes until the vegetables are very soft.
Remove the thyme sprigs and add the dates. Puree the soup in batches until very smooth.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Butternut Squash and Swiss Chard Chili
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A hearty combination of sweet butternut squash and chili pepper, strewn with Swiss chard and red kidney beans.
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, tough stems removed, chopped.
instructions: Add all ingredients except Swiss chard to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until squash is tender (about 15 minutes).
Stir in Swiss chard and simmer until chard is tender (about 4 minutes).
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cairo Garbanzo and Vegetable Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A quick and hearty vegetable soup for a large appetite. The beans are an excellent source of iron, fiber, and protein.
ingredients: 4 cups garbanzo beans, drained and washed.
2 tbsp italian herb blend, crushed fine.
instructions: Place all ingredients (except cashew butter) in a large pot.
Bring to a boil and then reduce heat. Cook for 20-25 minutes.
Add cashew butter and mix well for a creamy texture.
Remove the bay leaves. Ready to serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: California Black Bean Lettuce Wraps
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: This black bean lettuce wrap is warm weather favorite enjoyed all year long. It's fresh, it's crisp, it's sweet.
ingredients: 4 cup black bean, drained and rinsed.
1 large ripe avocado, peeled, pitted and mashed.
1 large green bell pepper, seeded and chopped.
16 leaf outer romaine lettuce, washed, organic 2 per person.
1 fruit (2" dia) lime, cut into 8 wedges for garnish.
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans.
In a bowl, mash avocado, garlic, and half of the beans together with a fork until well blended and chunky.
Add all ingredients except the lettuce and mix.
Serve each order per person with 2 large crisp romaine leaves.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Cambodian Lettuce Wraps with Ginger Plum Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fresh lentils, broccoli, sunflower seeds, onions, and peppers wrapped in crisp romaine leaf. Topped off with homemade ginger plum sauce.
ingredients: 1/8 tsp, ground black pepper, to taste only.
1 cup, pitted dried plums, for sauce.
instructions: Cook rice according to package.
On medium heat, saute onion, green pepper, red pepper, celery, garlic, apple sauce, and vegetable stock.
When onion is tender, add broccoli and continue to cook just long enough to lightly steam broccoli. Do not overcook.
In large bowl, combine lentils, brown rice, onion mixture, parsley, cilantro, lemon juice, no-salt seasoning, and black pepper. Mix until all ingredients evenly distributed.
Add walnut flour. Mix all the ingredients together until mixture holds a form.
Form into 6 football shapes and place on non-stick cookie sheet.
Bake at 350 for 20 minutes on one side. Turn over, flipping them lightly as they are fragile, and bake for an additional 20 minutes. Shapes will still be fragile, after removing from oven.
Allow to cool for 10 minutes. You can help them stay together by cupping them with your hands or by pressing them with the spatula.
In a food processor, blend 1 cup plums with 1 tbsp of grated ginger with 1/2 cup water until smooth. Add more water for desired consistency.
Wrap in lettuce leaves, drizzle sauce on top, and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Caribbean Vegetable Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Flavors of the Caribbean, with sweet and spicy overtones, come together in a great vegetable stew.
ingredients: 1 cup red bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices.
1 cup green bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices.
instructions: Put onion, red pepper, green pepper, thyme, cinnamon, allspice, black pepper, and cayenne in pot with 1/2 cup vegetable stock. Saute until tender (approximately 5 minutes). Adjust seasoning to taste.
Add zucchini and yellow squash, and saute for 3-5 minutes.
Add vinegar, collard greens, mushrooms, and mango. Simmer for 5-8 minutes.
Add remaining 1/2 cup vegetable stock and stir well. Simmer 3-5 minutes on low heat.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Carrot and Pineapple Coleslaw
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fresh pineapple and chopped carrots, with Goji berries and pecans, make this a naturally sweet and refreshing salad.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh pineapple chunks with juice.
1/4 cup shredded unsweetened coconut, reserving 2 tablespoons.
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except 1/4 cup of pecans and 2 tablespoons of coconut.
Sprinkle with remaining pecans and coconut.
recipes.prepInstructions: Served cold.

recipes.name: Carrot Ginger Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A careful balance of carrots, ginger root, parsnips, and black pepper. Great served hot or cold, for breakfast or dinner, this soup’s as smooth as it is versatile.
ingredients: 2 cups parsnip or sweet potato, peeled and roughly chopped.
4 cups no-salt added vegetable stock (add more to adjust consistency).
1 lb carrots, peeled and roughly chopped about 3 cups.
4 cups mandarin oranges or pineapple chunks.
instructions: Peel and trim onion and then cut into eighths. Place in a soup pot with 1/4 cup water or broth.
Cover and cook over medium low heat for 5 minutes. Add more liquid if needed to prevent sticking.
While onion is cooking, peel and chop the parsnip (or sweet potato if you prefer). Set aside.

Add to the pot: the garlic, ginger, and thyme. Stir to combine, cover and cook for 2 to 5 minutes, until the onion pieces are soft and translucent. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking, adding a small amount of liquid as needed.
Add the parsnips, baby carrots, dates, pepper and rest of water (or broth) to the pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered until the parsnips and carrots are soft (about 15 minutes).
Remove pot from heat and let cool slightly for a few minutes.
Carefully transfer soup mixture into a blender and puree until smooth. (Food processor will also work, though result is not as creamy.)
Return soup to pot and warm over medium heat before serving.
Garnish each serving with several slices of mandarin oranges or pineapple if desired.
recipes.prepInstructions: Enjoy hot or cold! Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Risotto with Roasted Red Peppers
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: The taste and feel of a creamy, Italian risotto made with cauliflower, and a squeeze of fresh lemon.
ingredients: 6 cups cauliflower florets, very finely chopped size of risotto rice grains.
1 cup roasted red bell pepper, sliced.
instructions: In a large sauce pot, saute the onion and garlic in vegetable stock.
Add cauliflower and cook until tender (similar to al dente).
In a small bowl, blend almond butter, lemon juice, lemon zest, and chives.
Add all remaining ingredients (except cauliflower and chopped almonds) and blend well.
Pour the blended mixture over the cauliflower.
Top with raw almonds.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cheesy Yellow Pea and Kale Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Incredible cheesy flavor in a dairy-free soup!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb kale, tough stems and center ribs removed, and leaves coarsely chopped (4-5 cups).
2 cups tomato sauce, no salt added.
instructions: In a soup pot, cover yellow split peas with about 4 cups of vegetable stock and cook on medium heat for 1 hour or until tender.
Add remaining ingredients except cashew butter and nutritional yeast and continue cooking for 5-10 minute.
Blend soup with cashew butter.
Sprinkle with nutritional yeast before serving.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cherry Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Cherries blended together with banana and cocoa powder for dark chocolate richness. Enjoy this healthy smoothie recipe.
ingredients: ice, may be needed to make this cold.
instructions: In a high speed blender, place all ingredients and blend till smooth and creamy. Ice may be needed to make cold.
recipes.notes: Keep refrigerated.

recipes.name: Chicken with Thai Vegetables and Brown Rice
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Organic chicken breast, mushrooms, snow peas and bamboo shoots, with garlic and ginger in a curry peanut sauce.
ingredients: 2 lb organic chicken breast, sliced as thin medallions.
3 tbsp natural peanut butter, no salt.
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package.
In a large saute pan, saute onion, red pepper, carrots, and bamboo shoots in vegetable stock until tender.
Add 2 cups carrot juice with snow peas, shiitake mushrooms, peas, no-salt seasoning, and curry.
In a food processor, blend garlic, ginger, mint, basil, and cilantro with 1/2 cup carrot juice. Add to vegetables.
Poach chicken on top of vegetables covered with a lid. Cook thoroughly.
Stir in coconut milk and peanut butter allowing to simmer for a short time.
For a thicker sauce, use an arrowroot slurry.
Garnish with peanuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Chili Bean Burgers
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Beans, oats and onions formed into patties, then seasoned with chili powder and cumin make a tasty, healthier burger.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp, ground black pepper, to taste.
8 leaf outer organic leaf lettuce, on the side.
8 slice, medium (1/4" thick) tomato, on the side.
8 slice, medium (1/8" thick) red onion, on the side.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350° F.
In food processor, put garlic, onion, and carrots. Pulse until small pieces-not puree.
Put mix in large bowl. Add chili powder, cumin, pepper, balsamic vinegar, dijon mustard, and tomato paste. Mix well so ingredients are distributed through out.
Add oats and blend well.
Blend in 2/3 of black beans.
Mash remaining 1/3 black beans with potato masher and combine with mix. Test to make sure mix holds together well.
Form patties and place on baking sheet that is lightly oiled with olive oil.
Bake for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes, turn burgers and cook for 10 minutes (25 minutes total).
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave burger for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Chili Tomato Lentil Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty and hearty soup made of lentils, onions, red peppers, and kale.
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper, seeded and diced.
2 cups loosely packed kale, tough stems removed, leaves chopped.
instructions: Place the lentils, vegetable stock, onion, carrots, red pepper, jalapeno, and basil in a pot and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the tomato, chopped kale, and celery and simmer for an additional 15 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Season with black pepper and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Chili Vegetable Burritos
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy Mexican favorite!
ingredients: 1 cup chopped red bell pepper, chopped.
1 cup loosely packed kale, packed, chopped 1" pieces.
2 cups black beans, drained and rinsed.
1 cup, chopped or sliced (15.0 oz) diced tomato, no-salt-added.
1/4 tsp red pepper flake, to taste.
instructions: Combine red bell pepper, onion, garlic, and kale in a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.
Remove from food processor and saute mixture in a small amount of vegetable stock until veggies are very tender.
Add beans, tomatoes, carrots, 1/2 cup of the salsa, and spices. Stir to combine, simmer until most of the tomato liquid evaporates, and then remove from heat.
To make burritos: Blend or mash together remaining 1 cup of salsa with avocado. Spoon beans and veggies onto tortillas, top with salsa/avocado mixture and roll tightly.
recipes.notes: Filling may also be used to fill tacos, top a taco salad, or dollop onto crisp vegetable slices such as raw zucchini.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Chinese Chicken and Broccoli
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Water chestnuts, cubed pineapple, broccoli florets, and baby corn—a delicious blend of Chinese cuisines.
ingredients: 3 cups no-salt added vegetable stock (more if needed).
1/2 cup pineapple, very small diced or minced.
1 1/2 cups, chopped red bell pepper, cut into 1 inch strips.
2 lb organic chicken breast, skinless and boneless, diced to bite size.
instructions: For this recipe it is important to prepped your ingredients first.
In a large sauce pan, with 1 cup of vegetable stock, saute the carrots, water chestnuts, baby corn, pineapple, red pepper, garlic, ginger, onions, and Braggs liquid aminos until carrots are soft.
Add broccoli and more vegetable stock, cover with lid and steam for 3-5 minutes being very careful not to overcook.
Add mushrooms and chicken on top of ingredients, cover with lid and cook thoroughly in the flavorful sauce.
Add black pepper.
Thicken stock/sauce with arrowroot slurry (vegetable stock and arrowroot).

recipes.name: Chived Bean and Potato Salad
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Get ready for the second Yukon Gold Rush. Adzuki and pinto beans, fresh chives, dill, and paprika might leave you wondering if heaven is indeed one giant potato salad. Let us ease your doubts with three words: homemade vegan mayo.
ingredients: 1 cup pinto bean, canned or cooked.
1 cup adzuki bean, canned or cooked.
1/2 cup raw cashew, soaked for 2 hours (optional).
3 fl tbsp lemon juice, (or more to taste).
instructions: Cut potatoes in bite-sized pieces and boil covered for 10 minutes (or until tender). Do not overcook.
Drain and let cool.
When potatoes are cool, add rest of ingredients (except for dill, paprika, and mayo ingredients) and carefully combine.
To make mayonnaise, add mustard, apple cider vinegar, no-salt seasoning, water, and cauliflower in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Add mayonnaise to potatoes and carefully combine to cover all ingredients.
Sprinkle with paprika and dill if desired.
May be served warm or refrigerate to serve cold.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Chocolate Blueberry Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: A tasty green smoothie that makes a perfect healthy dessert!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Chocolate Cake with Raspberry Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A fudgey chocolate cake with raspberry sauce.
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil, to oil pan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl and set aside.
In a high speed blender or food processor, combine all wet ingredients and blend until smooth.
Combine wet ingredients with dry ingredients and mix well (do not over mix).
In a half sheet pan, take olive oil and wet a paper towel, and coat the pan.
Add cake batter.
Bake for 40-45 minutes (or until toothpick comes out clean).
For raspberry sauce, heat raspberry spread and water in a microwave safe bowl for 1 - 2 minutes until the fruit spread has melted and is the consistency of sauce.
Stir well and pour over the chocolate cake.

recipes.name: Chocolate Dip
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty chocolate dip that uses cocoa, spinach, blueberries, and almonds to really pack in the nutrition.
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole raw almonds (preferably soaked for added smoothness).
instructions: Place all ingredients in a high-powered blender and blend until very smooth and creamy.
Serve with fresh fruit.

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Mousse
recipes.author: Chef Joseph Shilling
recipes.description: Peanut butter blended with ripe avocados, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract to make a creamy, chocolaty mousse - perfect for dipping berries and fresh fruit.
ingredients: 1/4 cup natural peanut butter (no salt added).
15 pitted dates, amount adjust for desired sweetness.
instructions: Place all ingredients in a high-powered blender. Blend well, until thick and creamy.
Additional water can be added for desired consistency.
May be served by itself or used as a topping for fresh fruit.
recipes.notes: Serve with 4 oz of mousse and garnish with 2 oz of berries.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.author: Gary Baron
recipes.description: Delicious chocolate breakfast treat. Great for after a workout.
instructions: Blend ingredients in a high speed blender until smooth. Add 1 cup of ice and blend.

recipes.name: Citrus-Lentil Dal
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty Lentil Dal together with mango and lemon.
instructions: Put lentils in a pan with vegetable stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low for low boil and simmer lentils for 15-20 minutes.
While simmering, add tumeric, garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, black pepper, and cinnamon.
Add lemon juice.
When lentils are soft, add tomatoes, onion, lemon, and mango and simmer 5-7 minutes.
Add jalapeno pepper and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add spinach and cilantro and simmer until spinach is wilted.
Taste and adjust spices if needed.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Co-Co Cherry Ice Cream
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy ice cream? You better believe it!
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a high-powered blender or food processor until smooth and creamy.
recipes.notes: Keep frozen.

recipes.name: Cool Cucumber Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Delicious dressing made from cucumbers, avocados, garlic, and vinegar.
ingredients: 1 small anjou pear, peeled and cut into quarters.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Cranberry Glazed Turkey Breast
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Organic, lean turkey breast with fresh sage, thyme, and cranberry sauce glaze.
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb turkey breast, organic, skin removed.
1/2 cup date sugar (add more according to desired sweetness).
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Quarter apples, oranges, and onions.
In a baking pan arrange apples, oranges and onion close together and lay herbs on top of fruit. Place breast on top of fruit, onion, and herb mixture.
Wash the cranberries and put into a sauce pot with date sugar (or chopped dates), orange juice, and orange zest.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes (or until berries are popped and soft).
Remove from heat, stir, and allow to cool.
Generously spread turkey with sauce and lay orange slices over it. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 30-35 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cream of Cabbage Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Smooth textured soup with chunks of cabbage and leafy greens.
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage, cut into pieces.
instructions: Place all ingredients in soup pot and cook until vegetables are soft (approximately 20-25 minutes).
Remove about 1/2 of the soup and put in a high speed blender until smooth and creamy.
Combine pureed soup with chopped vegetable soup.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Cream of Wild Mushroom Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A creamy blend of mushrooms that will never make you go to canned soup again.
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups no-salt-added vegetable stock (1/4 cup for steam sauteeing).
1 1/2 cups cannellini beans, cooked and drained.
instructions: In a soup pot, saute onion in 1/4 cup of vegetable stock until tender.
Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes.
In a high speed blender, blend until creamy and smooth.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Creamed Kale with Cashew Butter
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Kale gets a high score when it comes to nutrient content! Enjoy this super veggie in a creamy cashew dressing.
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable stock, more as needed.
1 cup unsweetened non-diary milk, more if needed.
1 tbsp no-salt seasoning, adjusted to taste.
4 bunches kale, leaves removed from stems and chopped.
instructions: In a sauce pot, saute onions in 1/4 cup of vegetable stock.
Blend cashew butter with non-dairy milk.
Add remaining ingredients (except kale) and allow to cook for 15 minutes or until it becomes a thick sauce.
Add kale and allow to wilt for 10-15 minutes until you have a nice, bright green, creamy kale.
recipes.prepInstructions:
Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.


For requests/dietary restrictions, possible substitutions for soy milk are hemp and almond milk.

recipes.name: Creamy Apricot Tahini Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Soaked apricots in almond milk blended with tahini and sesame seeds.
ingredients: 2 tbsp unhulled sesame seeds, lightly toasted.
instructions: Soak apricots in almond milk overnight in refrigerator.
Lightly toast sesame seeds in a pan over low heat pan for five minutes, shaking pan frequently.
Pour soaked apricots and almond milk, along with rest of ingredients, in a high speed blender and blend until smooth and creamy.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Creamy Corn Chowder
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Organic corn, sweet potatoes, celery, and scallions. Finally, a hearty soup that delivers in every sense of the word.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped sweet potato, 1/2 inch dice.
instructions: Place almond milk, 2 cups of corn, and avocado in the blender and puree.
Simmer the carrots, onion, celery, and sweet potato in vegetable stock.
When the vegetables are soft, combine the corn puree with the vegetables and stock. Bring to a hot temperature but do not allow to boil or the soup will curdle.
Stir in the scallions, 1/4 cup of corn and cilantro to finish.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Creamy Dill Dressing
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Creamy dressing, great for dipping veggies and full of fresh dill flavor. This is a healthier, better version of ranch.
instructions: Place all ingredients in high speed blender. Blend until smooth.
Add additional water as needed for desired consistency.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.
recipes.storageInstructions: Keep Refrigerated / Does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Creamy Herb Dressing
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: This dressing is cousin to the Creamy Dill and is every bit as flavorful; perfect for dipping broccoli and carrots or drizzling atop leafy mountains of romaine.
ingredients: 1 tsp ground black pepper to taste.
1 tsp, chopped basil, dried or fresh.
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a blender EXCEPT the herbs. Blend until smooth.
Add dill, thyme, basil, and parsley, then pulse to mix in without totally blending.
The dressing will thicken a bit in the refrigerator. This makes it good for a dip. May need to stir in some water or more lemon juice to reach desired consistency for a salad dressing.
Add more dill, onion powder, basil or other base seasonings as desired to "punch up" the flavor.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Creamy Onion Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Shakespeare invented slant rhymes to give great texture to his poems; this onion soup uses cauliflower, cashew butter, and black pepper.
ingredients: 1 tbsp onion powder, according to preference.
instructions: Heat 1/8 cup vegetable stock in a soup pot; add onions and simmer until translucent.
Add cauliflower and remaining vegetable stock and simmer for 25-30 minutes or until tender. Add no salt seasoning and onion powder.
Blend soup with cashew butter until smooth.
Add black pepper, lightly.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Creamy Roasted Eggplant Dip
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A creamy, roasted eggplant dip with garlic and currants. Best served with pita.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Take the eggplant and fork it several times.
Roast eggplant in oven for approximately 40 minutes (or until tender). Let cool.
When eggplant has cooled, remove inside of eggplant with a fork.
Combine diced tomatoes, bell pepper, large onion, garlic, and no salt seasoning in food processor.
Add eggplant to food processor and blend until smooth.
Remove from food processor and blend in currants.
Serve with a side of carrots, cucumber, celery, or pita for dipping.
recipes.prepInstructions: Best served cold.
recipes.storageInstructions: Keep refrigerated / Does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Creole Chicken
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Organic chicken breast with creole seasoning and lots of veggies: spinach, tomatoes, onions, and green peppers.
ingredients: 2 cups chopped green pepper, 1/2 inch dice.
3 tbsp tomato paste, no salt added.
1 tbsp chili powder, or to taste.
1/4 tsp red pepper flake, or to taste.
2 lb organic chicken breast, poached and sliced, 4 oz per person
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Water sauté the onion and garlic until the vegetables are very soft and all the liquid has evaporated.
Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable stock, the celery, and peppers and sauté on high heat, approximately 2 minutes, until all the liquid has evaporated.

Push the vegetables to the side of the pan, clearing a space for the tomato paste. Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook it, scraping the bottom of the pan, for 2-5 minutes. It will stick to the pan. Add the chili powder and red pepper flakes and mix well.
Add tomatoes and stock. Turn up the heat and bring to a simmer for about 5 minutes to bring all the flavors together.
Poach chicken in the flavorful broth covered to retain moisture, approximately 5-7 minutes.
Turn off the heat and stir in the fresh basil, parsley, and spinach with the poached chicken and stir so that the chicken is completely covered by the vegetables and sauce.
Serve with brown rice.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Crimini Mushrooms and Stewed Vegetables
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Savory stewed vegetables cooked in tomatoes, garlic and basil for a tasty vegetarian dish with Italian zest.
ingredients: 2 medium red pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces.
2 medium green pepper, cut into 1 inch pieces.
3 medium zucchini, sliced crosswise 1 inch thick.
2 medium yellow squash, sliced crosswise 1 inch thick.
2 medium eggplant, cut into 1 inch dice.
instructions: In a flat large pan put onion, garlic, red peppers, and green peppers, with 1/4 cup vegetable stock.
Saute until tender for about 5 minutes. Do not over cook.
Add zucchini, yellow squash, and eggplant. Add 1/4 cup of vegetable stock (if needed). Saute for 5 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, crimini mushrooms, oregano, basil, and no-salt seasoning. Add 1/2 cup of vegetable stock (if needed).
Simmer on low heat until eggplant is cooked for about 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes. Serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A tasty nutritarian coleslaw made with a variety of cabbages, carrots, and raisins, combined with a sweet cashew dressing.
ingredients: 1 cup red bell pepper, thinly sliced.
1/2 tbsp unhulled sesame seeds, lightly toasted.
instructions: Mix all salad ingredients together.
In a high powered blender, blend soy milk, apple, cashews, and vinegar and toss with salad.
Garnish with currants and lightly toasted sesame seeds.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Cucumber, Pear, and Basil Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: The freshness of the herbs and cucumber is a great balance with the garlic.
ingredients: 1 oz water, as needed for consistency.
instructions: In a high speed blender or food processor, blend all ingredients until smooth and creamy.
Small diced cucumber can create a chunky texture if desired.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Curry Chickpeas and Sweet Potatoes
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Stewed chickpeas and sweet potatoes with fresh ginger and curry seasoning.
ingredients: 4 cups sweet potato, peeled and diced.
2 tbsp cider vinegar, or to taste.
instructions: In a large soup pot, place sweet potatoes and vegetable stock and cook until sweet potatoes are tender. Drain well.
Saute peppers until tender add remaining ingredients and mix well.
recipes.notes: Also nice to serve with brown rice.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Edamame and Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A colorful stir fry filled with Edamame, beets, tofu, carrots, celery, and seasonings.
ingredients: 1/4 cup no-salt-added vegetable stock, more if needed.
2 blocks extra-firm tofu, drained and cut into 1 inch cubes.
instructions: Roast whole beets wrapped in foil until tender (about an hour).
Cool and thinly slice.
Saute carrots and celery in 1/4 cup vegetable stock.
Add remaining ingredients except tofu and beets and simmer until beet greens are tender, approximately 7-10 minutes.
Add tofu cubes and beets and simmer for an additional 5-10 minutes to allow tofu to absorb the sauces and spices.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Eggplant Roulade
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Peppers, onions, and tomato sauce wrapped up in an eggplant.
ingredients: 2 large eggplant, peeled and sliced into thin, flat long strips.
2 tsp Italian herb seasoning, crushed fine.
instructions: Marinade eggplant slices in a mixture of balsamic vinegar and 2 tablespoons water for one hour.
After marinading, drain eggplant and pile in a baking pan that has been lightly oiled. Bake at 350°F degrees for 20 minutes, until flexible.

Meanwhile, sauté pepper, onion, and garlic in 1/4 cup water over medium heat until water is cooked down; then add tomato sauce, chopped tomatoes, and seasoning. Simmer for 10 minutes to make the filling.
Take the strips of partially cooked eggplant, spread a layer of the tomato sauce mixture in the middle and roll up. Place in baking dish and cover with the remaining tomato sauce mixture.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Fresh Greens and Veggie Salad
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Healthy, fresh, and simple. This salad goes great with the Healthy Caesar Dressing.
ingredients: 2 cups green bean, cut into 2 inch pieces.
instructions: Put the greens in a salad bowl.
Place 6 cherry tomatoes around each salad.
Arrange the cucumbers, red onions, carrots, radishes, and green beans on each salad.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Fresh Tomato and Asparagus Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Asparagus mixed with healthy greens and toasted pine nuts.
ingredients: 2 lb asparagus, tough ends removed, cut into 2 inch pieces.
instructions: Steam asparagus until just tender, about 4 minutes.
Rinse with cold water to stop cooking and drain.
Place mixed greens in a bowl and top with cherry tomatoes.
Add asparagus, red onions, radishes, and toasted pine nuts.
Top lightly with fresh ground black pepper.
Serve with one of our tasty dressing recipes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Fresh Vegetable Salad with Avocado
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: "Great things will come to those who eat green," said someone, once. Well, this salad is as green as it gets: fresh greens, avocado, chopped scallions, and plenty of other fresh garden veggies.
ingredients: 2 medium red bell peppers, thinly sliced.
3 large carrots, grated or cut thin for carrot curls.
1/4 cup raw pumpkin seeds, no salt.
instructions: Assemble salad with greens as base.
Rinse avocado with lemon juice so it does not brown.
Serve with one of our tasty dressing recipes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Fruit and Berry Green Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Assorted fruits over a bed of mixed baby greens.
instructions: Place mixed baby greens in a bowl.
Clean and chop melon into bite size pieces.
Wash berries and grapes. and
Place cherry tomatoes around perimeter of salad, add cucumber on top.
Add melon and grapes and top with berries.
Garnish with lime wedge.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Fruit Filled Baked Acorn Squash
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: This dish trumps them all, and though it might sound aggressive, trust us, it’s not. Acorn squash, raisins, walnuts, and cinnamon come together like old friends in a celebration that’s both warm and tasteful.
ingredients: 4 large acorn squash, cut in half and seeded.
1 cup unsulfured dried apricots (soaked until soft in just enough water to almost covert), then diced.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Cut squash in half, remove seeds, and bake face down in ½ inch of water for 30-40 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine apricots and soaking liquid, pineapple, raisins, and walnuts.
When the squash has cooked, scoop the fruit/nut mixture into the squash’s center. Place in pan and cover loosely with aluminum foil. Bake for an additional 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Fruitilicious Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A morning fruity salad filled with a delicious blend of mixed greens, fennel, cucumber, pear, and mandarin oranges topped with walnuts and a cinnamon applesauce dressing.
ingredients: 4 cups mandarin oranges, 8 slices per salad.
4 cups cucumber, peeled, halved, and sliced thin.
2 oranges juiced (1/2 cup of orange juice).
instructions: Combine mixed greens, fennel, pears, mandarin oranges, and walnuts in a large bowl.
Blend applesauce, orange juice, and cinnamon.
Pour blended mixture over salad and toss.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Garbanzo Bean and Apple Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Garbanzo beans, cherry tomatoes, red bliss potatoes, and Brazil nuts bedded atop a beautiful field of greens.
ingredients: 2 medium green apples, peeled, cored, and chopped.
4 cups garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed.
8 medium red potatoes boiled, peeled, and chopped into chunks.
instructions: Mix lemon with 1/2 cup water and soak green apples for 3 minutes to prevent browning/discoloration.
Layer all ingredients on salad greens and garnish with 2 tablespoons Brazil nuts.
Serve with one of our tasty dressings.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Garden Salad
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Try this healthy garden salad featuring cucumber, onion, and avacado!
instructions: Slice cucumber, onion, and avocado.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Pair with your favorite salad dressing!

recipes.name: Garden Salad with Apples
recipes.author: Eugene Pevzner
recipes.description: Easy salad that is delicious and nutritious.
instructions: Place organic mixed baby greens in a bowl.
Grate apples and zucchini.
Chop tomatoes, cucumbers, and thinly slice onions.
Sprinkle with a pinch of salt or dried herbs.
Add raw seeds and dried berries.
Add apple cider vinegar, mix, and serve.

recipes.name: Garden Sauté
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Many different fruits and vegetables sauteed together to make one delicious dish!
ingredients: 1 cup organic vegetable juice, low or no sodium, no salt, no sugar.
1 medium red bell pepper, cut in strips.
1 large apple, peeled, cored, and diced.
1 cup green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces.
instructions: In a large sauté pan, add 1/2 cup of vegetable juice, garlic, red onion, red pepper, celery, and carrots.
Sauté on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. Do not overcook! If corn and peas are fresh, not frozen, add to above and sauté.
Add apple, broccoli, and green beans. Sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add more vegetable juice as needed.
Flash cook mushrooms in a separate pan or microwave for 30 seconds.
Add remaining vegetables (including mushrooms) and vegetable juice as needed.
Sauté until all vegetables are soft but not overcooked. It is okay if vegetables still have a snap to them.
Add basil and parsley at end. Mix well.
Can garnish with basil, parsley, and tomatoes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Golden Cauliflower Soup
recipes.author: Chef Robin Jeep
recipes.description: Tender cauliflower makes a creamy soup, with garlic and greens. It's a family favorite.
ingredients: 2 cups no-salt-added vegetable stock, additional as needed for consistency.
2 large heads cauliflower, cut into pieces.
3 tbsp no salt seasoning blend, or to taste.
2 cups loosely packed kale leaves, chopped.
instructions: Place all ingredients except the kale and cashew butter in a large soup pot.
Cook until vegetables are tender, approximately 20-25 minutes.
Stir in cashew butter.
Add kale and cook for 10 minutes.
In a high speed blender or with a stick blender puree until creamy and smooth.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Goodness Green
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: This is the smoothie that transformed my girlfriend from GOTTA-HAVE-MY-PANCAKES to an all-star smoothie maker. Over many mornings we developed it and are confident you'll love it, whether you're a seasoned smoothie maker or just starting out. Importantly, the kale, nuts, and fiber give it a high dose of micronutrients with great absorption and lots of fiber. It has a terrific balance of flavor -- freshness from the kale, creaminess from the soy milk (or any other non-dairy milk), sweetness from the fruits, an earthy and nutty taste from the oats and walnuts. It makes me look forward to energized mornings and a perfect way to start my day. I know it will for you too! Please let me know what you think and suggestions you have in the comments below!
instructions: Any type of blender will work. Just put everything in, blend, and enjoy!

recipes.name: Grandma's Favorite Baked Sweet Potato
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A spiced mix of roasted sweet potatoes, apples, and walnuts.
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes, peeled and large diced.
1 cup granny smith apple, cored and diced.
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees.
In a bowl, toss all ingredients.
Place on a baking pan and cover with aluminium foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, covered and 10 minutes uncovered. Check with a fork to ensure dish is done.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Green Apple and Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: It is a little known fact that every morning, out in the Garden, Adam and Eve enjoyed a bowl of this soup for breakfast. And now you can too; of course, wearing your garnish while you eat is still just an option.
ingredients: 2 cups loosely packed kale, tough stems and center ribs removed and leaves chopped.
instructions: Place squash, applesauce, kale, onion, balsamic vinegar, and carrot juice in a soup pot. Bring to a boil, lower heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes or until kale is tender.
Puree 3/4 of the soup with the milk and cashews and hemp seeds in a food processor or high-powered blender.
Return blended mixture to soup pot and add cinnamon and nutmeg.
This soup is great anytime. It makes a quick and delicious breakfast. Make it the night before, refrigerate, and then reheat before serving.
recipes.notes: Add additional water if necessary to thin.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Green Salad with Pear and Cherry Tomato
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: This salad is cool as a cucumber and will no doubt romaine with the menu for a long long time to come. It pears excellently with the Ginger Pear Dressing.
instructions: Toss pear in lemon juice so it does not turn brown. Drain well.
Toss all salad ingredients together.
If desired, sprinkle with additional currants.
recipes.notes: Goes very well with the Ginger Pear dressing.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Hand Rolled Oven Baked Spinach Falafel with Tahini Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Spinach and whole wheat pita with unique blend of veggies and spices.
ingredients: 3 tbsp no-salt-added vegetable stock, for consistency.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In a food processor finely grind sesame seeds and flax seeds.
Add chickpeas and grind until smooth.
Add onion, garlic, parsley, lemon juice, black pepper, paprika, cumin, and no salt seasoning and blend well.
Scrape down sides of processor bowl, add garbanzo flour, and blend well.
Add spinach with the water squeezed out and blend well.
Roll into 1 ounce balls. Place on baking sheet, lightly oiled with olive oil.
Bake for 20 minutes then let cool.
For the tahini sauce, combine all sauce ingredients in blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Garnish with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, and diced red onion on the side.
Serve with pita and tahini sauce.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave Falafel for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Healthy Caesar Dressing
recipes.author: Chef Robin Jeep
recipes.description: An awesome, healthy Caesar salad dressing that uses no Parmesan cheese or anchovies.
ingredients: 1 cup water, as needed for desired consistency.
instructions: Place all ingredients into a high speed blender. Blend until smooth and creamy.
If too thick, add water, small amounts at a time.
recipes.notes: The following ingredients could be adjusted to desired taste: lemon juice, dijon mustard, garlic, black pepper.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Healthy Carrot Cake with Creamy Cashew Icing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Finally, a healthy cake that takes the... well, takes it all; conquers taste buds; has eaters believing magic is real, and once again asserts the power of vegetables - even in desserts - supreme. If you don't believe us yet, just wait until you try the cashew cream.
ingredients: 2 cup unsifted, dipped whole wheat pastry flour.
1 cup carrot juice, for sauce, may need more as desired.
1 1/3 cup, whole or halves raw macadamia nut, unsalted for cream.
1 cup soy milk, for cream, more as desired.
1/2 medium(16.0 oz) butternut squash, frozen for sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl.
In a food processor or high speed blender, blend all wet ingredients and process until blended.
Mix the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and blend well, but do not over mix.
Bake 35-40 minutes. Check with a toothpick to ensure it is done.

Butternut Lemon Sauce: Place squash, date sugar and carrot juice in a pan and cover. Simmer for about 15 minutes, or until squash is tender. Puree squash with carrot juice, lemon juice, lemon zest and lemon extract. Keep warm and drench warm cake with it.
To make Cashew Cream, blend nuts, vegan milk and dates until smooth and creamy. Place dollop over each piece of sauce drenched cake.
recipes.notes: Special occasion dessert.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Healthy Cranberry Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A blend of cranberries and orange to make a delicious treat whether served cold or warm.
ingredients: 1/2 cup date sugar, add more to desired sweetness.
instructions: In a sauce pot, place all ingredients and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until all berries pop.
Remove from heat and allow to cool.
recipes.prepInstructions: Can be served warm or refrigerate and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Healthy Gingerbread Cake with Butternut Lemon Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty combination of spices makes this your new favorite gingerbread cake.
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, peeled and cut into chunks for sauce, or 1 10 oz bag frozen butternut squash.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
In a high speed food processor place all wet ingredients and pulse until smooth.
Combine wet ingredients into the dry ingredients.
Mix well but do not over mix.
Lightly oil the cake pan.
Pour batter into pan and smooth evenly with a spatula.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until toothpick clean.
For Icing: Place all ingredients (macadamia nuts, soy milk, and dates) in high speed blender and puree smooth and creamy or until desired texture. Additional soy milk may be needed.

For Butternut Lemon Sauce: Combine all ingredients (butternut squash, date sugar, carrot juice, lemon juice, lemon zest, and lemon extract) in a sauce pan and cook until butternut squash is tender. Use a high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Serve cake with icing and sauce on the side.
recipes.notes: Special occasion dessert.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Healthy Hummus (Low Oil)
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: This is a really easy recipe and turns out to be some of the best and healthiest hummus you can have - most hummus I ever get out of my house has so much oil in it. This one only has a tablespoon! The best part is that you can use it as a dip or spread. Tell me what you think in the comments below! Also, you may want to check out my Sweet Red Bean Hummus, a sweet twist on this recipe :) Note: This recipe requires you to soak beans overnight. We prefer not to use canned beans because they have more than 4 times the sodium and nearly 3 times the calories! You'll want to save the water from soaking the beans. You'll need this to give the hummus a more spreadable consistency since you won't be using a ton of oil.
instructions: Boil beans that were soaked overnight until firm, but no longer hard (or softer if desired).
Put all the ingredients in the blender and add 2 tablespoons of the water from the beans you saved. If you forget, just add some filtered water and you'll be fine. Blend all the ingredients together.
Add more water from the can of beans (or filtered water) a tablespoon at a time and re-blend until you get the consistency you want.

Serve with fresh carrots, baby carrots, celery, or a no-salt blue corn tortilla chip. This also makes a great spread on a whole grain bread or veggie sandwich. Comment below and tell us what you ate it with and what you thought!

recipes.name: Healthy Oat Bars
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: The perfect breakfast bar for on the go!
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
In a large bowl mix together all dry ingredients.
In a high speed food processor blend together all wet ingredients.
Mix together the dry and the wet ingredients.
Let sit for 15 minutes so the oats absorb the wet ingredients and do not end up dry.
Very lightly oil coat the full size and half size pans.
Pack firmly into pans the oat bar mix.
Put pans in oven and bake for 30 minutes for a light golden brown.
Remove oat bars from pans to cool.
Cut out 4 ounce oat bars. Wrap as desired.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Healthy Pumpkin Pie
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A Healthy Food Now Thanksgiving favorite! Flaky pie crust with a cinnamon and nutmeg pumpkin filling. Oh, and it just happens to be guilt-free...
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Pie Crust: Mix oats, almonds, flour, and date sugar. Add water to dry ingredients and mix until it holds together. You may need to add a little more water.
Spray 9-inch pie dish lightly with cooking spray and press the crust to thinly cover the bottom and sides of the pie dish.
Pie Filling: In a blender combine the pumpkin and date sugar. Add raisins, spices, arrowroot powder, and tofu and blend until smooth.
Pour mixture into pie shell and bake for 15 minutes, then lower heat to 350 degrees. Cover crust with strips of aluminum foil to prevent burning, and bake for an additional 35 minutes.
Cashew Cream: Blend all ingredients together in a high speed blender.
Serve slightly warm or cold with a dollop of Cashew Cream.
recipes.notes: The pie filling will firm up as it cools. Special occasion dessert.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve slightly warm or cold.

recipes.name: Healthy Ricotta
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy Food Now's Ricotta cheese without the Ricotta!
instructions: Drain and squeeze water from tofu.
Drain and squeeze water from spinach.
Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Season to taste with lemon juice.
recipes.prepInstructions: Eat cold or microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Healthy Tomato Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy Food Now's delicious no salt tomato sauce that goes with any dish!
ingredients: 3 1/2 cup canned crushed tomatoes, no salt.
3 1/2 cups tomato sauce, no salt added.
instructions: Water saute the onion, garlic, and carrots in vegetable stock until the vegetables are very soft and all the liquid has evaporated.
Add crushed tomato, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic powder, and oregano. Simmer for 30 to 45 minutes.
Add dates and puree.
Stir in fresh basil.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Hearty Oatmeal
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A flavorful blend of fruits, vegetables, oats, and seasoning sprinkled with pecans and cinnamon to brighten up your morning.
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks, fresh or frozen.
instructions: Whisk together spices, oatmeal, flax seed, and carrots.
Combine almond milk, pineapple, and pumpkin in a blender and briefly puree (the mixture should be combined but still chunky).
Whisk the almond milk mixture into the dry ingredients and stir in the raisins.
Microwave covered, for 6 minutes.
Garnish each serving with chopped pecans and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
recipes.prepInstructions: Must be microwaved for 6 minutes on high with lid, more if needed.

recipes.name: HFN Signature Salad
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: An amazingly well-balanced, nutritious salad, full of greens, mushrooms, onions, berries, nuts, and seeds.
ingredients: 40 mushrooms slices (roughly 6 mushrooms), blanched in lemon water, 5 slices per salad.
24 medium strawberries, cut in half, 3 strawberries per salad.
8 tsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp per salad.
instructions: Put lettuce in salad bowls.
Add cherry tomatoes around outer edge.
Lightly blanch mushrooms in microwave for one minute.
Layer remaining ingredients with nuts and seeds last.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Hoppin' John
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Black-eyed peas, garlic, sage, onions, and peppers, this classic dish from the South is typically served on New Year’s Day and symbolic of romance, good fortune, and—in this case—amazing health.
ingredients: 2 cup brown rice, long grain, steamed.
2 cups onion, 1/4 inch dice about 1 medium onion.
2 cups chopped green bell pepper, 1/2 inch dice.
1 tbsp jalapeno pepper, seeds and ribs removed, minced about 1 small whole jalapeno.
2 cups chopped scallion, sliced use green and white parts.
instructions: For rice, follow package instructions.
Saute the onion and garlic in vegetable stock until very soft.
Once they start to stick to the pan, add more stock and the celery, peppers, jalapeno. Cook until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the tomatoes, bay leaf, oregano, thyme sprigs, sage, paprika, and no-salt seasoning and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Stir in the black eyes peas and heat through. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Add the rice and gently combine.
