Then add the scallions and vinegar.
Adjust the seasoning with lemon juice and steam so ingredients are not browned.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Irish Cabbage, Leek and Parsnips Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Simple, savory, and healthy: we start by replacing the mashed potatoes with parsnips, then top them with roasted garlic, stewed cabbage, leeks, and mushrooms.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs parsnip, peeled, cut into 1 inch pieces, and mashed.
3 large leeks, white and pale green parts only, washed and thinly sliced.
1 medium head of green cabbage, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces.
1/2 tsp ground black pepper, to taste.
instructions: Peel and cut parsnips into 1 inch pieces.
Cover parsnips with 2 cups of vegetable stock and cook until tender.
Drain parsnips and put in food processor with soy milk and garlic. Pulse until smooth then set aside.
Water saute leeks, cabbage, red peppers, and carrots for 5 minutes, until vegetables start to soften.
Add remaining stock, bring to a boil, partially cover, and simmer over medium heat, stirring often, for about 10 minutes (or until vegetables are tender). Add additional vegetable broth if needed.
Stir in the vinegar, caraway seeds, and mushrooms. Cook for at least 1 minute.
Add black pepper.
Serve with mashed parsnips and enjoy!
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Italian White Bean and Vegetable Saute in Balsamic
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A combination of garden vegetables with an Italian flavor tossed with cannellini beans and drizzled with balsamic reduction.
ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar (or 1/4 cup balsamic glaze instead of reducing).
2 medium red peppers, seeded and sliced.
2 cups cannellini beans, drained and rinsed.
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in vegetable stock over medium-high heat in a large skillet until translucent.
Add eggplant, stir and cover. Cook for about 10 minutes until the eggplant is completely cooked through and soft, adding small quantities of vegetable broth, if needed, to prevent sticking.
Make balsamic reduction by simmering 1 cup balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan until syrupy and reduced to about 1/3 cup. Set aside.
Add zucchini, yellow squash, and red pepper and cook for 5 minutes, until zucchini begins to soften but is still firm.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Italian seasoning and basil, cannellini beans and pepper. Stir and heat through
Serve and drizzle with the balsamic syrup.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Jamaican Me Crazy Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Toss the croutons and sink the iceberg, the captain of salads is back! Crisp romaine, fresh corn, black beans, scallions, tomato, cilantro, and cucumber -- topped with homemade mango salsa.
ingredients: 4 cups black bean, drained and rinsed.
2 cucumbers, chopped to desired sized pieces.
1 lime, cut into 8 wedges, 1 wedge per salad.
instructions: Arrange lettuce in bowl(s).
Top with all the ingredients.
To make mango salsa, put all ingredients in food processor and pulse until consistency of small dice.
Put 1/4 cup of mango salsa in the center of the salad.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Kale Mango Breeze
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: Mango and banana are a terrific combination. You'll appreciate the taste of this smoothie considering it has 2 servings of raw kale and a nutty afterthought.
instructions: Note: We recommend using frozen mango because it's easier to handle than unfrozen and has similar nutrition.
Blend all ingredients together in the blender.

recipes.name: Kaleabration Smoothie Recipe
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Celebrate your healthy choices with this delicious kale smoothie!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Kiwi Lover Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Kiwi lovers -- this one is for you!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Lemon Spiked Lentil Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tender lentils in a lemony vegetable broth that brings your palate alive.
ingredients: 1 cup red (or green) lentils, rinsed and drained.
1/4 tsp ground black pepper (or to taste).
instructions: Put vegetable stock and lentils in a large sauce pot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients except spinach and parsley and simmer for 15 minutes until lentils are tender. Do not overcook lentils.
Turn off heat and add spinach and parsley. Adjust seasoning as needed.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Lemony Garlic Bean Hummus
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Does your black bean hummus deserve a high five? Enjoy this healthy, dairy-free dip; perfect for a snack or entertaining.
ingredients: 4 cups black beans, drained and rinsed.
4 tbsp fresh lemon juice, to taste.
instructions: Blend all ingredients (except the paprika) in food processor or high powered blender until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add lemon juice or water for consistency as needed.
Garnish with paprika.
Serve with vegetables or pita.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold. Pita can be warmed- microwave for 30 seconds.

recipes.name: Lime Cilantro Dressing
recipes.author: Deb Carney
recipes.description: Zesty dressing with unique blend of lime, cilantro, and dates.
instructions: In high speed blender, blend lime juice, cilantro, garlic, rice vinegar, and dates until mixed to liquid consistency.
If needed, add a little water or more rice vinegar to taste.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Mango and Mixed Greens Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A refreshing salad with sweet mango that will take you to the tropics.
instructions: Toss celery, peppers, onions, cherry tomatoes, and mango in a bowl (you can also layer ingredients on top of lettuce).
In a bowl, place lettuce and top with ingredients.
Top with no-salt seasoning and chili powder (to taste).
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Marinated Kale (with a kick)
recipes.author: Coach Jodi and Chef AJ
recipes.description: The ginger and red pepper flakes spice up this colorful, low-sodium, high-nutrient side.
ingredients: 5 tbsp raw and unsalted almond butter.
12 oz roasted red peppers, cut in strips.
instructions: Cut and clean kale, removing stem. If using washed and cut kale, check for stems and remove them.
Put kale in a large bowl.
In blender, put all remaining ingredients except roasted red peppers. Blend until smooth and pourable. Add more water and red pepper flakes, if desired.
Combine dressing with kale.
Refrigerate 1 hour so kale can absorb dressing and wilt.
Garnish with the roasted red pepper strips.
recipes.notes:
Unsalted peanut butter is a possible substitute for almond butter.

If placing the kale into a container or plate, allow the kale to wilt in the marinade prior to packing; this way it will appear fuller and make for better presentation.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Mashed Cauliflower with Greens
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: The better mash, with spinach for extra points.
ingredients: 2 tbsp no-salt seasoning blend, adjusted to taste.
1 cup unsweetened non-dairy milk, if needed.
instructions: Boil cauliflower in vegetable stock for 20-25 minutes.
Drain cauliflower well by allowing to drain for 5 minutes.
Place in food processor.
Add all ingredients except spinach.
Blend until smooth and creamy. If needed, add more non-dairy milk.
Water saute spinach and stir into cauliflower.
Reheat if necessary.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Mashed Winter Squash
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Seasonal squash instead of the potatoes makes a colorful, healthy addition to any table, during the holidays or otherwise.
ingredients: 2 lb winter squash, fresh or frozen.
instructions: Peel squash.
In a large saucepan, bring squash, leeks, and vegetable stock to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer covered until the squash is tender (about 30 minutes). Drain well.
Transfer the vegetables, nutmeg, and no-salt seasoning to a bowl and mash with a potato masher.
Add cinnamon.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Mexicali Salad with Fresh Salsa
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Mixed greens topped with beans, corn, tomatoes, avocado, salsa, and fresh cilantro. Best with lime cilantro dressing.
ingredients: 4 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed.
1 cup roasted red pepper, thin sliced.
1 large ripe avocado, cut into 8 pieces.
instructions: In a food processor, blend the salsa ingredients until chunky.
Place greens in a bowl.
Top with remaining ingredients using corn and cilantro as top layer for color presentation. Top with 1 slice of avocado per salad.
Top each salad with 2-3 tbsp salsa.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chicken
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Organic chicken breast and tons of healthy greens with a blend of seasoning made from dates, garlic, cinnamon, and lemon.
ingredients: 2 lb organic chicken breast, cut into strips (4 oz per person).
instructions: In a large sauce pot, add all ingredients except chicken and kale. Cook for 10 minutes.
Place chicken on top of sauce. Cover with a lid and cook for 5 minutes. Stir with sauce.
Add kale, cover, and let wilt about 5 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Muscle Smoothie
recipes.author: Gary Baron
recipes.description: Great after a workout. High in vitamin K, A and C.
instructions: Blend ingredients together in a high speed blender until smooth. Add 1 cup of ice and blend.

recipes.name: No-Meat Meatloaf
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Make sure you try it with the plum ketchup! And forget about the stuffing, this healthy and hearty "no-meat loaf" will be a family favorite.
ingredients: 1 package (16oz) sofu tofu, drained and patted dry with paper towel.
1 tbsp no-salt seasoning, adjusted to taste.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix arrowroot powder, water, aminos, and tofu together in a high-powered blender. Add walnuts & blend until smooth.
Saute onions, celery, and mushrooms in water with seasonings and herbs until vegetables are soft, stirring occasionally.
In a bowl, mix together tofu mixture, vegetables, bread crumbs, and cooked rice.
With a paper towel, spread a small amount of olive oil in a loaf pan. Add mixture to pan and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Let cool for 30 minutes. Turn loaf out and slice.
For plum ketchup, blend plums, garlic, ginger, and water until smooth.
recipes.notes:
Excellent with the plum ketchup. 
May be served with low sodium ketchup and thinly sliced raw onion.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Not-Your-Momma's Lasagna
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A hardy, classic Italian pasta dish that's kind to the body. This lasagna is bursting with garlic and tomato sauce and layered with a creamy soy cheese filling.
ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets, cut into 1 inch chunks.
2 cups carrots, cut into 2 inch chunks.
2 cups healthy ricotta (see healthy ricotta recipe).
3 cups healthy tomato sauce (see healthy tomato sauce recipe).
instructions: Place vegetables and garlic on a sheet tray and roast at 350 °F for about 20 minutes (until they are soft and begin to wrinkle). Do not let them brown.
While the vegetables are roasting, combine the healthy ricotta and spinach in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse to combine.
Place the roasted vegetables, oregano, and Italian seasoning in a food processor, reserving half of the veggies for chunky consistency. Add the tomato sauce and pulse until you have a chunky sauce.
In a 8.5 by 11 inch pan, spread 1 cup of tomato sauce on the bottom. Place three noodles in a single layer on the sauce.
Spread 1 cup of the ricotta spinach mixture then top with the chunky vegetable sauce, then with three lasagna noodles.
Continue until you have 3 layers. Top the final layer of noodles with tomato sauce and daiya mozzarela.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350°F for about 45 minutes until it bubbles around the edges.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Nutty Almond Dip
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Chocolate almond creaminess. You'll like this one.
ingredients: 2/3 cup pitted dates, add more as desired.
instructions: Place all ingredients, except berries, in high speed blender, and run until creamy and smooth. Additional soy or almond milk may be needed.
Serve with berries.
recipes.notes: For special occasions.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Nutty Portobello Mushroom Chili
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: You’ll go crazy for this one. Portobello mushrooms, adzuki beans, and bell peppers, spiced with cumin and chili powder, then garnished with cashew nuts and fresh cilantro.
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes.
4 cups adzuki bean, drained and rinsed.
2 cups green bell pepper, finely chopped.
1/2 tsp ground black pepper, more to taste.
instructions: In a large pot, add onions and a little vegetable stock. Put on lid to steam them on low heat for about 5 minutes (until they begin to soften).
Remove lid, and continue to saute, stirring occasionally, for about 5 more minutes (until they are transparent).
Add mushrooms, garlic, chili powder, and cumin and saute for 2 minutes more.
Add the tomatoes, sweet potato, beans, black pepper, and vegetable stock and mix well. Cover and simmer until sweet potato is tender (about 30-40 minutes).
Remove from the heat, stir in the bell pepper, cashews, and cilantro. Add a little vegetable stock if the chili seems too dry.
Season with more pepper, to taste.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Nutty Truffles
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Quick, sweet, and a little nuts - they sound like the kids! Must be the perfect snack.
ingredients: 1 cup natural peanut butter, no salt.
3 tbsp unsweetened soy or almond milk.
instructions: In a food processor, blend coconut, cocoa, peanut butter, dates, rolled oats and non-dairy milk until smooth (use only enough milk to hold the mixture together).
Roll into 40 balls (to serve 5 pieces per person).
Roll into chopped peanuts. Have as is or frozen.
recipes.notes: For special occasions.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold or frozen.

recipes.name: Orange Avocado Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Sweet, creamy citrus dressing made from orange, bananas, avocado, and papaya.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a food processor or high powered blender until creamy.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Orange Crush Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Fresh oranges in this smoothie will make mornings something to look forward to!

recipes.name: Orange Peanut Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A perfect combination of oranges and peanut butter.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp fresh ginger, peeled or 2 tbsp grated ginger.
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a high powered blender until smooth.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Orange Sesame Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: One of our favorite salad dressings! Tastes of cashews, sesame, and citrus.
ingredients: 1/4 cup orange juice, no added ingredients (if needed to adjust consistency).
instructions: Place all ingredients in a high speed blender. Secure lid and blend until smooth and creamy.
Add more orange juice to water to get desired consistency.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Orange, Beet and Fennel Salad
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: It’s sweet with a touch of the exotic; in other words, everything you ever wanted. In a salad.
ingredients: 4 cups mandarin oranges, drained (8 pieces per salad).
1 cup seeded cucumber, peeled and sliced.
instructions: Put mixed greens in salad bowl.
Place ingredients on top of salad, arranging for visual sense.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Oven Baked Tofu in Mushroom Sauce
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Marinated tofu topped with a delicious mushroom sauce.
ingredients: 2 lb extra-firm tofu, drained, water removed.
5 cups no-salt-added vegetable stock (more if needed).
2 large red bell peppers, seeded and sliced.
4 portobello mushrooms, stem and gills removed, sliced into 1 inch pieces.
1 tbsp italian seasoning blend, crushed fine.
6 tbsp arrowroot powder, or Tapioca flour, as needed.
instructions: For the marinade: combine all the ingredients.
Slice tofu in half into 1/2 inch slices, then cut again to make 8 pieces, about 2 by 4 inches.
Place the tofu in a single layer in a shallow pan and cover with marinade. Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes. Flip the tofu halfway through baking.
For the sauce: sauté onion, red pepper, and garlic in 2 cups of vegetable stock until very soft.
Add mushrooms and cook covered, until the mushrooms release all their juices. Stir in seasonings and black pepper.
Whisk 1 cup of vegetable stock with the arrowroot starch to make a slurry.
Add the slurry and remaining 2 cups of stock to the mushrooms and whisk together so there are no lumps. Bring to a boil, then turn down the heat and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the lemon juice, then the parsley.
Place one piece of tofu on each plate with about a tablespoon of the marinade. Pour one cup of sauce over the tofu slice and serve hot.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Papa's Pumpkin Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Rich, strong spiced pumpkin taste. A perfect pumpkin soup to warm you up.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic until tender, approximately 5 minutes.
Place all ingredients in a soup pot, bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are soft (approximately 10-15 minutes).
In a high speed blender or with blender stick, puree until smooth and creamy.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Peaches 'N' Cream (Green) Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: A healthy peaches and creme smoothie (with strawberries and spinach!).
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: This sweet smoothie is sure to please -- even the kids!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Pear Ginger Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Pear, ginger, and lemon keep this dressing sweet and give it just the right amount of bite.
instructions: In a high speed blender or food processor put all ingredients and blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust as needed.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Pinto Bean Enchiladas with Green Tomatillo
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A burrito so good that it doesn't need the cheese. Fresh corn tortillas, bean, and bell peppers.
ingredients: 1 medium green bell pepper, cut into 1 inch strips.
1/2 cup onion, cut into 1 inch strips.
1 15 oz can pinto beans, drained and rinsed 2 times.
1/4 cup cilantro, washed and minced leaves only.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Saute green pepper and onion in half the tomato sauce until they begin to soften.
Add the pinto beans, corn and spices. Stir to combine and heat through.
Stir in the cilantro.
For the sauce: Oven roast tomatillos and onion for 15 minutes.
Place the tomatillos, onion, garlic, and jalapeno in a blender and puree. Add the cilantro and pulse to combine. The sauce should be smooth, with flecks of cilantro.
Add the lime juice to sauce. Taste and adjust.
To make the enchiladas: Take the corn tortillas and wrap them in a moist towel. Heat them in the oven for about 10 minutes. Be careful not to overcook, or they will crack into pieces.
Take tomato sauce and add 1/2 cup of water.
Drench corn tortilla in tomato sauce to moisten.
Place the warm tortilla on a board. Fill with 1/4 cup pinto bean mixture.
Roll gently and place in baking dish. Cover with tomatillo sauce.
Warm in oven.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Pistachio Mustard Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Creamy mustard dressing made with a touch of seasoning and garlic powder.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups unsweetened soy or almond milk.
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth in a high-powered blender.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Poached Salmon and Vegetables
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Poaching is a great way to quickly cook fish and vegetables; it allows flavors to playfully mix together without exposing the surface of the food to heat (and avoid unwanted carcinogens).
ingredients: 1 pinch ground black pepper, to taste.
2 lbs salmon filet, divided into 8 pieces (4 oz per person).
instructions: In a bowl, mix black pepper, ginger, parsley, and lemon juice.
Cut salmon into 4 ounce pieces and toss gently in lemon juice mix to coat.
In a large bowl, mix tomatoes, zucchini, carrots, celery, red onion, and garlic.
In a large saute pan, put all vegetables except mushrooms and mustard greens. Saute with vegetable stock until almost tender (al dente).
Add mushrooms, mustard greens, and salmon and put a lid over pan. Steam until salmon is cooked.
To serve, place vegetables on bottom with salmon pieces placed on top.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Portobello Veggie Fajitas
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Tasty vegetable fajitas with portobello mushrooms and peppers, zucchini, and onions.
ingredients: 4 large portobello mushroom caps, cut into strips.
2 large red bell peppers, cut into strips.
1 large red onion, sliced about 1 1/2 cups.
1/2 cup chopped or diced green chilies.
16 cherry tomatoes, cut in 1/2 for garnish.
instructions: Combine mushrooms, peppers, zucchini, and onion.
Heat 2 tablespoons of stock in a large skillet or wok and add chopped garlic, chili powder, cumin and canned chilies (including liquid). Stir to combine.
Add the prepared vegetables and sauté until tender, stirring to coat with spices (about 5-6 minutes). Add more stock, a tablespoon at a time, if needed to prevent sticking.
Toss with lime juice and cilantro before serving.
Garnish with 1/2 cherry tomatoes and cilantro sprigs.
Serve with warm whole wheat tortillas.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Post-Work Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: A great smoothie to fuel your body after a work!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Power Workout Smoothie
recipes.author: Gary Baron
recipes.description: Great after a workout. High in Protein. Rich in Vitamin A, K, C, B6, folate and magnesium.
instructions: If you have a powerful high speed blender you can use raw, uncooked quinoa. If not, you can use cooked quinoa.
Blend ingredients together in a high speed blender until smooth.
Add 1 cup of ice and blend.

recipes.name: Pure & Simple Apple Sauce
recipes.author: Lisa Baron
recipes.description: Simply Delicious Apple Sauce
instructions: Peel and core apples. Cut into 1/4 size chunks.
Add water to large sauce pan.
Add apples and 3 cinnamon sticks broken in halves.
Cover and cook on low until desired thickness.
Refrigerate until serving. Enjoy this natural, sweet and incredibly delicious apple sauce without a bit of added sugar!

recipes.name: Quinoa, Beet and Arugula Salad
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: A gorgeous salad that tastes as great as it looks.
instructions: Bake beets at 350 degrees in foil until tender (about an hour).
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
While beets are baking and quinoa is boiling, wash arugula and tomatoes.
Slice the avocado and drench with lemon juice so they do not turn brown.
Cool beets, peel, and and chop in little cubes.
Put arugula in bowl and layer ingredients putting walnuts on last.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Rainbow Salad
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: A colorful salad that tastes as good as it looks!
ingredients: 2 cups red bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices.
2 cups orange bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices.
2 cups yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch slices.
instructions: Put lettuce in bowl.
Layer all ingredients on top of lettuce and serve with dressing of choice.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Red Pepper Hummus
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: Add another dimension to your hummus with roasted red peppers, blending it in AND as a garnish on top. Pair it with a side of raw veggies, or if you're going big, serve it with our Baked Sweet Potato and Tofu Falafels!
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 450.

Slice the peppers into wide slices and remove any white on the inside part of each slice. Lay a sheet of tin foil on a baking pan and lay the slices on it facing up. Place the peppers in the oven on the top shelf (under the broiler) and cook for about 15 minutes until the tops are completely blackened.
After the peppers are blackened, remove from the oven, place in a bowl, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Remove the peppers from the bowl and peel off the blackened skin. Set aside two slices to put on top as a chopped topping.

Put the roasted red peppers (except for the ones you've put aside) and all other ingredients in the blender. Blend all the ingredients together until smooth. Add more water a teaspoon at a time for a smoother consistency.

Finely chop the two roasted red peppers put aside and put them on top. Garnish with fresh ground pepper. Serve with fresh carrots, baby carrots, celery, or warm pita. This makes a great spread for a veggie sandwich and our Baked Sweet Potato & Tofu Falafel.
Comment below and tell us what you ate it with and what you thought!

recipes.name: Refreshing Gazpacho Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Traditionally from Spain, this summer soup is cool, refreshing, and -- made without the traditional bread or oil -- is plenty healthy.
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled and sliced into large pieces (plus extra slices for garnish).
1 large red bell pepper, seeded and sliced into large pieces.
1 cup roasted red pepper, in vinegar, drained.
1 tbsp no-salt seasoning blend, adjusted to taste.
instructions: Place all ingredients into a high speed blend and blend until finely chopped, but not pureed.
Cover and chill for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
Before serving, garnish with cucumber slices. Serve chilled.
recipes.notes: Garnish with sliced jalapenos for some extra heat!
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Roasted Garlic Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Creamy roasted garlic dressing made with almonds, pumpkin seeds, white wine vinegar, and fresh thyme.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
With a sharp or serrated knife, slice off the tips of the cloves of the garlic pod.
Roast unpeeled garlic bulb in a small baking dish for about 25 minutes or until soft.
When cool, squeeze out the soft cooked garlic, removing and discarding the skins.
Blend the garlic with non-dairy milk, garlic powder, almonds, pumpkin seeds, mustard, nutritional yeast, and vinegar in a high-powered blender until creamy and smooth.
Stir in thyme.
recipes.notes: Soy milk can be substituted with almond or hemp milk.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper & Tomato Soup
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Hearty roasted tomato and pepper soup with just a little kick.
ingredients: 1 cup yellow onion, peeled and chopped.
4 cups roasted red pepper, chopped, drained of juice, seeds and excess blackened skin.
1 tbsp tomato basil garlic flavor seasoning.
1/4 tsp red pepper flake, or to taste.
instructions: Heat a couple of tablespoons of vegetable stock in a soup pot and sauté carrots, onion, and garlic for about 10 minutes, until translucent. Add stock as needed to keep vegetables from sticking to the pan.

Add the carrot juice, tomatoes (including juice), chopped peppers, remaining vegetable stock, tomato basil garlic flavor seasoning, red pepper flakes, and black pepper and simmer over low heat for about 30 minutes.
Carefully ladle 3 to 4 cups of the soup into a blender. Add the raw cashews and blend until smooth.
Pour the blender mixture back into the soup pot. Stir to combine and heat through. Serve and enjoy!
recipes.notes: For home-roasted peppers, rather than canned, use 6 red bell peppers, halved without stems or seeds. Place them cut-side down (skin-side up) on a non-stick baking sheet. Broil about 8 inches from the heat source for about 10-12 minutes, until the skins are blackened and blistery. Remove the peppers to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let them sweat for 15 minutes. (Sweating in a brown paper bag works equally well.) Then remove peppers, peel off the blackened skin as much as possible and chop for this recipe.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper Tomato Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fresh and light, this dressing is great on a salad or for dipping veggies.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until creamy.
Add more vegetable stock to thin, if desired.
recipes.notes: This dressing is fat free and excellent for dipping, especially asparagus.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Rockin' Raspberry Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: This raspberry smoothie is a great dessert smoothie!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Salad Mania
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A mixture of fruits, greens, and nuts, topped with toasted sesame seeds makes this salad sweet, crunchy, and all around awesome.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh tangerine sections (or mandarin oranges), drained, 8 slices per salad.
1/2 cup dried unsulphured apricots, coarsely chopped.
1/4 cup unhulled sesame seeds, lightly toasted.
instructions: Arrange all ingredients on a platter or in the bowl.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Sauteed Greens with Pine Nuts in Balsamic
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Sweet balsamic glazed mustard greens with red onion, bell peppers, and carrots.
ingredients: 2 small red onions, very thinly sliced.
3 bunches mustard greens, mixed spinach, kale or seasonal greens.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Lightly toast pine nuts for 4 minutes. Set aside.
Bring 1/2 cup vegetable stock to a boil, add garlic, peppers, carrots, and red onion and cook over medium-high heat until tender.
Add raisins, no-salt seasoning, balsamic, and greens. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for about 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, adding more vegetable stock if necessary.
Garnish with toasted pine nuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Savory Sweet Peach Crunch
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Peaches, chopped walnuts, cinnamon, and nutmeg will leave you feeling both healthy and satisfied after dessert.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Place peaches in baking pan.
Top with walnuts, currants, oats, and dates and spread evenly.
Add water and orange juice.
Top with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add additional cinnamon if desired.
Cover with foil. Bake for 25-30 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sesame Almond Veggie Wrap
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A wonderful combination of fresh vegetables with the Asian flavors of ginger and garlic, ready to be embraced by wrapping in a lettuce leaf.
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, cut diagonally into 1/3 inch pieces.
2 red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1 inch squares.
16 lettuce leaves (romaine, boston or bibb ideally) for wrap.
instructions: In a large sauce pot, water saute onions, carrots, red peppers, until tender.
Add broccoli and cook 3-5 minutes, do not overcook.
Add spinach, bok choy, and mushrooms and cook for 2-3 minutes.

For the sauce, combine raw almond butter, unsweetened non-dairy milk, unhulled sesame seeds, dates, garlic, ginger, hot pepper flakes, and water into a high speed blender and blend until smooth and creamy. Stir in cilantro.
Toss sauce with vegetables (you may have to drain vegetables if there is too much liquid).
Mixture is now ready to be rolled in a lettuce leaf.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve at room temperature.

recipes.name: Sesame Veggie Stir Fry
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fresh pineapple, broccoli, baby corn, and water chestnuts with natural Asian flavors, served over brown rice.
ingredients: 1 cup fresh pineapple, cut into chunks.
1 large onion, cut into wedges and seperated.
1/4 cup sesame seeds (reserve 1 /8 cup for garnish).
1 cup snow peas, chopped (or sugar snap peas).
instructions: For brown rice, prepare according to package directions.
In a large skillet, stir together the pineapple chunks, apricot fruit spread, garlic, aminos, and sesame oil.
Add vegetables (except spinach and snow peas) to the mixture and saute 6-7 minutes (or until vegetables are tender).
Add 1/8 cup toasted sesame seeds to vegetables.
Set aside 1/8 cup toasted sesame seeds for garnish.
When vegetables are done, add the peas and spinach.
Heat and stir for a minute or two until peas are heated through and spinach is wilted.
Serve with rice.
Sprinkle with reserved sesame seeds.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Shades of Green Salad
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: How many shades you may ask? Is it steamy enough to wilt the lettuce? Well, it starts with Doylestown Fresh Greens, kiwi fruit and Belgian endive; then some raw, unsalted pistachios and some delicious peas...
instructions: In a bowl, layer the mixed greens.
Chop the arugula into bite-sized pieces and place them on top of the mixed greens.
To prepare the endive, cut off the bottom and remove any damaged or discolored outer leaves.
Break or chop the endive into pieces about 1 inch in size.
Rinse and drain. Add endive to salad.
Spoon the peas on top of the greens.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Top the salad with kiwi slices, cucumber, and shelled pistachios.
Serve with one of our delicious salad dressings.
recipes.notes: Pistachios may be substituted with avocado as another source of healthy fat.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie with Lentils and Sweet Potatoes
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy eaters of old once spent long days in the pasture, watching over the flock and working up appetites. And, just like you, they also did their best to make the kids eat their greens. So eat up now with this classic, savory favorite.
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes, peeled and diced.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Cook the lentils in 2 1/2 cups of vegetable stock until soft, but not mushy (about 25 minutes).
Prick the back of the potatoes with a fork and bake until soft (about 1 to 1.5 hours).
Peel and mash the potatoes and set aside.
Meanwhile, saute the onion, garlic, celery, and mushrooms in a small amount of water (for 5 minutes, until soft).
Add the cooked lentils to the mixture.
Stir in the rest of the vegetables, including the carrots, beans, peas, and corn.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and the tomato paste (you may need to add some water if it's too dry).
Add thyme and parsley.
Mix thoroughly.
Transfer lentils and veggie mixture to a 2 quart casserole dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Simply Green Salad
recipes.author: Chef Joseph
recipes.description: A plentiful, nutritious green salad; comes with cherry tomatoes that will burst and homemade spiced walnuts.
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, tough stems removed and diced.
instructions: Chop the greens and put them in a bowl.
Distribute the cucumber, celery, broccoli, scallions, and asparagus on top of the greens.
Put the cherry tomatoes around the outside of the salad.
In a small bowl, dampen the walnuts with water so they are a bit moist to hold spices.
Add the spices to the walnuts and toss well.
Put the spiced walnuts on top of the salad.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Simply Guacamole
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: Like most great recipes, it's about simplicity. This applies especially to guacamole; it's a simple dip that revolves around one ingredient and shouldn't be muddled with too many flavors. We start with the main star: the avocado. Everything else is there only to accentuate the avocado and let us enjoy different nuances of it's creamy, earthy taste. Here's a simple guacamole recipe that I hope you'll enjoy! Leave a line in the comments below and tell us what you think :)
instructions: Slice, de-pit, and scoop the avocado meat into a bowl and mash them. Leave some chunks if you like.
Rough chop the cilantro, finely chop the onions and garlic, and add them to the bowl with the mashed avocado.
Add lime juice and crack black pepper into the bowl.
Mix and serve with fresh, raw veggies; carrots, red pepper, celery go great with it! You can also find some low- or no- salt blue corn tortilla chips.

recipes.name: South of the Border Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Call the border patrol and cordon off all plates, this is one you won’t want to share. Black beans, stewed eggplant, bell peppers and squash are seasoned with chili powder, cumin, bay leaf and oregano. Get it quick, before it’s out of your jurisdiction.
ingredients: 2 cups long grain brown rice, cooked.
2 cups black beans, drained and rinsed.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Water saute the onion and garlic in 1/4 cup of vegetable stock.
Stir and cook until all the liquid has evaporated and the onions are soft (about 10 minutes).
Add the eggplant and another 1/4 cup of vegetable stock.
Simmer until all the liquid has evaporated and the vegetables start to stick to the pan.
Stir in the spices, herbs, and seasonings (except bay leaves) and stir well.
Add the peppers, jalapeno, squash, and zucchini and another 1/4 cup of vegetable stock.
Simmer until all the liquid has evaporated and the vegetables are al dente.
Add the diced tomatoes and bayleaves.
Stir and bring to a simmer.
Add the remaining vegetable stock and black beans and bring to a simmer.
Turn down the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Remove bay leaves before serving.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with Tomato, Zucchini, Mushrooms and Sweet Basil Sauce
recipes.author: Chef Joseph Shilling
recipes.description: Spaghetti topped with vegetables and tomato sauce.
instructions: Cook the pasta in water (with no salt or oil) according to package.
Sauté the onion, peppers, and garlic for 2 minutes, until tender.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms, and herbs.
Sauté for 2 minutes, but do not overcook the vegetables.
Add more water if needed.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer on low for 2 minutes.
Toss pasta with the sauce and serve, topped with toasted pine nuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spicy North African Chicken
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tender eggplant, chickpeas and Moroccan spices ... it's delicious and savory, and saves the price of a plane ticket to North Africa.
instructions: In a sauce pot, saute onion, garlic, and carrots in 1/4 cup vegetable stock.
Cook until carrots are tender (Approximately 5 minutes).
Add more stock if needed.
Add eggplant, red peppers, garbanzo beans, ginger, and spices.
Cook until eggplant is fully cooked (Approximately 10-15 minutes).
Add remaining stock and diced tomatoes.
Place sliced chicken on top of vegetables, cover with lid and steam until cooked thoroughly.
Simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Top with fresh chopped parsley.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spicy Okra and Lentil Stew
recipes.author: Chef Robin Jeep
recipes.description: Hearty stew made from lentils, okra, tomatoes, and onions. Seasoned with garlic, chili powder and a touch of natural peanut butter.
ingredients: 2 cups no-salt-added vegetable broth, as needed for desired consistency.
16 oz okra, frozen, thawed and cut in half crosswise.
2 tbsp no-salt seasoning blend, adjusted to taste.
1/2 cup natural blanched peanut butter, smooth.
instructions: Put lentils, carrot juice, and vegetable broth in a pot.
Simmer 10-15 minutes until lentils start to get tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (except for the tomato paste and peanut butter) and simmer for 20 minutes (or until sweet potatoes are soft/cooked).
Add the tomato paste and peanut butter.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spicy Tofu with Hazelnuts and Vegetables
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A little sweet and just enough spicy. Broccoli, tofu, and hazelnuts topped with scallions, ginger, and a touch of date sugar.
ingredients: 16 oz tofu, water pressed out and cubed.
instructions: To make sauce, whisk together water and almond butter until well combined.
Add vinegar, date sugar, aminos, ginger, and cayenne.
Bring sauce to a boil.
Add carrots, red peppers, garlic, and onion.
Cook until carrots are tender (approximately 4-5 minutes).
Add broccoli and tofu.
Cover with a lid to steam broccoli. Do not overcook.
Garnish with scallions and chopped hazelnuts.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spicy Tomato Soup
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Tomato soup with a kick!
ingredients: 1 tsp red pepper flakes (adjust to taste).
instructions: Chop tomatoes, garlic, onion, and celery.
Combine all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Adjust red pepper flakes to taste.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend soup in a high powdered blender until smooth.
Reheat in soup pot and serve!

recipes.name: Spicy Vegetable Curry
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy spin on a traditional Asian dish.
ingredients: 1 cup red bell pepper, seeded and thinly sliced.
1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes.
2 cups green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces.
1 cup sliced bamboo shoots, drained and rinsed.
2 tbsp no-salt seasoning, adjusted to taste.
1 lb firm tofu, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices.
instructions: Place the garlic, ginger, mint, basil, cilantro, carrot juice, and peanut butter in blender and pulse until herbs are chopped fine.
Pour sauce, bell peppers, eggplant, green beans, mushrooms, bamboo shoots, no salt seasoning, curry powder, and 1 cup of the watercress in a wok or large skillet.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until all the vegetables are tender.
Add the tofu, bring to a simmer, and toss until hot.
Add the coconut milk and heat through.
Top with the remaining 1 cup of watercress and the cashews.
Garnish with mint, basil, or cilantro if desired.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Spiked Swiss Chard
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Healthy Swiss Chard with a twist of orange and allspice blend.
ingredients: 4 bunches swiss chard, stems removed, chopped.
instructions: In a large pot, add onion, garlic, oranges (minus 8 slices), orange juice, all spice, chili flakes, balsamic vinegar, and no-salt seasoning.
Bring to boil.
Add Swiss chard.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add remaining orange slices.
Toss with Swiss chard.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Squash and Kale with Pumpkin Seeds
recipes.author: Chef Robin Jeep
recipes.description: Braised kale, butternut squash, onions, and pumpkin seeds cooked in sweet, black fig vinegar.
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash, peeled, seeded, and cubed
2 tbsp no-salt seasoning blend, adjusted to taste.
2 bunches kale, tough stems and center ribs removed, leaves chopped.
1/2 cup raw pumpkin seeds, lightly toasted.
instructions: Saute the vegetable stock and balsamic vinegar with the squash, onions, garlic, and no-salt seasoning for about 20 minutes (or until squash is tender).
Add kale, and cook an additional ten minutes.
Add raisins and garnish with pumpkin seeds.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Steel Cut Oats with Cajun Seasoning
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Oatmeal that's savory? Yes, believe us, it works. Tumeric and Cajun seasonings, spinach and mushrooms, are slow cooked into steel cut oats. It makes an awesome side dish or meal to go.
ingredients: 1 oz sundried tomato, soaked until softened and chopped.
instructions: Add all ingredients (except spinach) to pot and heat to boiling.
Turn down to a simmer, stirring occasionally until the water is absorbed and the oats are creamy.
Stir in the spinach.
Take off the burner, cover, and let sit until the spinach is soft.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Strawberry Limeade Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: A great balance between tart and sweet.
instructions: Combine squeezed lime juice, strawberries, baby kale, banana, apple, flax seed, and water and blend until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Strawberry Mango Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: An easy, fruity smoothie for beginners!
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.

recipes.name: Summertime Blast Smoothie
recipes.author: Kayla Sheely
recipes.description: Summer is here and has brought lots of fresh fruit to celebrate!
instructions: Add strawberries, blueberries, cherries, and banana in blender.
Squeeze oranges into blender.
Add water and blend until desired consistency. Adjust water as needed.
Sprinkle chia seeds on top.

recipes.name: Super Healthy Soup New
recipes.author: Dr. Fuhrman
recipes.description: Soup packs a punch full of flavor and disease-fighting power!
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, tough stems removed and chopped fine.
1/2 cup French lentils, cooked in 2 cups of vegetable stock.
instructions: Bring vegetable stock and carrot juice to a boil.
Add all the vegetables (excluding kale), turmeric, no-salt seasoning, dill, lemon juice, and cashews, and simmer, covered, for about 15-20 minutes (until the vegetables are soft).
Purée until smooth.
Stir in the chopped kale, lentils, and parsley.
Add black pepper.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Super Veggie Bean Stew
recipes.author: Chef Robin Jeep
recipes.description: A flavor combination from the Middle East, with seasonal vegetables strewn in a savory broth.
ingredients: 2 cups garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained.
instructions: Saute the leek, carrot, and garlic until tender.
Add the remaining ingredients except for the mushrooms, cauliflower, and broccoli.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce to simmer.
Add the remaining vegetables and cook until tender (do not overcook).
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet and Spicy Parsnip Soup
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Parsnips, potatoes, and mushrooms with a blend of herbs and spices make a soup that's sweet and spicy.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, or to taste.
1/4 lb yukon gold potatoes, peeled and chopped.
instructions: In a soup pot, use a couple tablespoons of vegetable stock to sauté the onion and garlic over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Stir in the cilantro, cumin, ginger, red pepper flakes, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, turmeric, and nutmeg.
Add the stock, apple cider, parsnips, applesauce, and mushrooms.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered until the parsnips are tender (about 20 minutes).
In small sauce pan, cook the potatoes. Reserve for garnish.
In a blender or food processor, purée cooked ingredients (except for potatoes and a small portion of mushrooms).
Add the spinach to the soup.
Add black pepper.
Add the potatoes and a few sliced crimini mushrooms to each soup for garnish.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet Cucumber Basil Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A slightly sweet dressing made from cucumbers, basil, avocados and garlic.
ingredients: 1/4 cup water or more for desired consistency.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together in a high speed blender until smooth and creamy.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Sweet Pea Soup
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: Dried split peas combined with sweet potatoes make for one delicious soup!
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and chopped.
instructions: Rinse dried peas.
Simmer peas in 4 cups of vegetable broth, covered, for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, sauté the onions in 2 tablespoons of vegetable broth or water over low heat until soft (about 5 minutes).
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Add the onions to the peas along with the celery, sweet potato, applesauce, bay leaf, and mint.
Bring mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes (or until peas and vegetables are soft).
Remove the bay leaf.
Place half of the mixture in a blender and blend until creamy.
Pour back into soup.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato and Leek Stew with Green Beans
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes and green beans with figs, spinach, and mushrooms. Garnished with fresh mint, parsley, and lemon.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped into bite-sized pieces.
2 tbsp no-salt seasoning, adjusted to taste.
2 large leeks, cut into 1/2 inch pieces (white and pale parts only).
1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces.
instructions: In a sauce pot, mix the sweet potatoes, figs, red pepper, carrots, no-salt seasoning, garlic, and lemon juice with 2 cups of vegetable stock and cook until the sweet potato is tender.
Add the leeks, green beans, and shiitake mushrooms and cook until the green beans become tender (do not overcook).
Stir the spinach, parsley, and mint with the vegetables.
Turn off heat and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Fries with Chili Aioli
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: No salt, no oil, and all the sweet potato goodness.
ingredients: 4 large sweet potatoes, organic and washed.
3 tbsp chili powder, for chili aioli.
3 cloves garlic, chopped for chili aioli.
2 tbsp lime juice, for chili aioli.
1 tsp cayenne pepper, to taste, for chili aioli.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Peel sweet potatoes if not organic. Cut into strips.
Lay on a non-stick cookie sheet.
Sprinkle garlic powder and onion powder on potatoes.
Bake approximately 45 minutes, turning potatoes every 15 minutes or until tender and lightly browned.
To make chili aioli, blend HFN Mayo, chili powder, garlic, lime juice, and cayenne pepper together until mixed well.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet Red Bean Hummus
recipes.author: Sean Baron
recipes.description: This recipe is similar to my Healthy Hummus, with the addition of raisins. It's a fun twist on hummus, great for parties and for getting the kids to eat their beans. Enjoy and comment below to let us know what you think! Note: This recipe requires you to soak beans overnight. We prefer not to use canned beans because they have more than 4 times the sodium and nearly 3 times the calories!
instructions: Boil beans that were soaked overnight until firm, but no longer hard (or softer if desired).
Put all the ingredients in the blender and add 2 tablespoons of the water from the beans you saved. If you forget, just add some filtered water and you'll be fine. Blend all the ingredients together.
Add more water from the can of beans (or filtered water) a tablespoon at a time and re-blend until you get the consistency you want.
Serve with fresh celery, or cucumber. If you can find a healthy wheat or multi-grain cracker, they go great with this dip! Comment below, tell us what you ate it with and what you thought!

recipes.name: Sweet Red Beet Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: From HFN with love, this Sweet Beet Soup is a better, more nutritious version of borscht.
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and bite-size, boiled separately in stock or water.
instructions: Remove beet leaves and set aside.
Bake beets at 350 degrees.
Cook sweet potatoes until tender. Drain and use as garnish.
Put vegetable stock, no-salt seasoning, carrot juice, and celery in a pot and simmer.
Peel beets.
Chop beets, onions, and beet greens.
Add to stock pot.
Cook on low heat for 30-40 minutes.
Puree the soup until smooth.
Add sweet potato slices to soup.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve hot or cold. Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Sweet Strawberry and Watermelon Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A great salad for any time of year.
instructions: Lightly toast pine nuts in a 350 degree oven for 3-4 minutes (keep an eye on them, pine nuts toast fast!).
Arrange greens in salad bowl.
Top with watermelon, strawberry slices, red onion, pine nuts, and mint leaves.
Serve with one of our tasty dressings.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Thai Peanut Marinated Kale
recipes.author: Coach Jodi and Chef Joseph
recipes.description: Slightly sweet and a little spicy: super nutritious kale that comes with a light, thai peanut flavor.
ingredients: 1/4 cup peanut butter, 1/4 cup natural peanut butter, without salt..
1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, to taste.
1/2 cup roasted red pepper, cut into strips.
instructions: Remove stems from kale and coarsely chop the leaves, yielding about 4 cups.
Blend all ingredients, except for kale and roasted pepper, until a creamy dressing (add more water if needed).
Toss kale and dressing in a large bowl.
Refrigerate and let marinate for 1 hour or longer, even overnight (the salad should be soft).
Use roasted red pepper strips for garnish.
Serve.
recipes.notes: If placing the kale into a container or plate, allow the kale to wilt in the marinade prior to packing; this way it will appear fuller and make for better presentation.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Thai Tofu with Spicy Kale
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Soft tofu and kale in a spicy peanut sauce. Topped with fresh scallions.
ingredients: 4 cups firm tofu, drained well, cut into 1 inch cubes.
2 tbsp no-salt seasoning blend, to taste.
3 bunches of kale, stems and center ribs removed, leaves chopped.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Place tofu cubes on a lightly oiled baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, turning after 15 minutes.
Heat a large saute pan and add onion, ginger, carrots, red peppers, and jalapeno chili.
Cook until carrots have softened, adding 1-2 tablespoons of vegetable stock as needed to prevent sticking. Add chili powder and cook for one more minute.
Stir in vegetable stock, peanut butter, tomato paste, and no-salt seasoning and bring to a boil.
Gradually add kale a few handfuls at a time, stirring to let it wilt down.
Add baked tofu.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes or until kale is tender.
Stir in lime juice and top with sliced scallions.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwaved on high for 1 – 2 minutes

recipes.name: The Best Mousse You'll Ever Eat
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Indulge in the creamy, chocolate, mousse that you won't be able to put your spoon down.
instructions: Place all ingredients in a high speed blender.
Blend until smooth.
For desired texture, additional water may be used.
For more sweetness, additional dates may be used.
recipes.notes: Special occasion dessert. Not suitable for diabetics. Serve 4 oz of mousse with 2 oz berries
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Thousand Island Dressing
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy blend of cashews, dates, and cucumbers.
instructions: Divide onions and cucumbers in half amounts. Set aside.
Put all other ingredients in a high-speed blender. Blend until smooth.
Add remaining cucumber and onions.
Stir well.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Tofu Saute Scramble
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: This dish is the perfect substitute for scrambled eggs! Tofu, spinach, peppers, and mushrooms make the ultimate scramble.
ingredients: 4 cups firm tofu, drained and crumbled.
1 tsp ground black pepper, to taste.
instructions: Drain tofu in colander wrapped with 3 layers paper towels. Put weight on top to squeeze out liquid.
While the tofu is draining, wash and cut the vegetables.
Squeeze tofu by hand to get remaining liquid out.
Over medium heat, heat 1/4 cup of vegetable stock in a sauté pan.
Saute the minced garlic and red bell peppers for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, mushrooms, and scallions.
Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tofu and seasonings (careful when stirring to keep tofu in large pieces).
Add the spinach and lightly saute.
Serve immediately.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold or Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Tomato Spinach Eggplant Rolls
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy, delicious blend of flavors!
ingredients: 2 eggplants, peeled and sliced lengthwise 1/2 inch thick.
3 cups chopped red bell pepper, 1/2 inch dice.
1 cup no-salt-added vegetable stock, for cooking.
1 tbsp Italian seasoning, crushed fine no salt.
1 tbsp no salt seasoning blend, adjusted to taste.
4 cups fresh spinach, steamed and chopped, liquid squeezed out.
instructions: Brush the bottom of two sheet trays with the olive oil.
Lay the eggplant slices in a single layer on the sheet trays.
Brush the eggplant with balsamic vinegar and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, until soft and completely cooked through.
Meanwhile, sauté the onion and garlic in vegetable stock until they are very soft and the liquid has evaporated.
Add the red peppers and two tablespoons of vegetable stock.
Sauté until al dente, about 2 minutes.
Stir in Italian seasoning and no-salt seasoning.
Stir in one cup of tomato sauce and the spinach.
Cook for 5 minutes, just long enough for all the flavors to come together.
Add the parsley.
Scoop 2 cups of tomato into a 11 X 8 baking dish and spread it to cover the bottom of the pan.
Lay the slices of cooked eggplant on a cutting board.
Scoop 1/3 cup of red pepper-spinach filling onto one end of the eggplant.
Roll it up and place it seam-side down into the baking dish.
Repeat until you have used up all the eggplant slices and they fit snuggly into a single layer in the pan.
Cover all eggplant roll-ups with the remaining 4 cups of tomato sauce.
Sprinkle the shredded, non-dairy cheese on top and cover with foil.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.
Let it sit for 5 to 10 minutes after removing from the oven and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Tortilla Soup with Crispy Tortilla Strips
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Tasty vegetarian tortilla soup. It'll keep you warm in winter and keep you going in the summer. It even has crispy tortilla strips.
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic powder (to taste, for tortilla strips).
1 tsp chili powder (to taste, for tortilla strips).
1/2 cup mild green chilies, chopped or diced.
9 cups vegetable stock (more to adjust consistency).
2 cups pinto beans, drained and rinsed.
instructions: Cut tortillas into 1/4 inch by 1 inch strips.
Rub one tablespoon of olive oil on a baking sheet.
Spread tortilla strips on the tray and dust with garlic powder and chili powder.
Bake at 300°F for 20 minutes.
Water sauté onion, garlic, and green peppers in vegetable stock until the vegetables are very soft and all the liquid has evaporated.
Add chili powder, oregano, and cumin.
Add tomatoes and simmer on high heat until the mixture becomes thick (about 10 minutes).
Tear chilis open and remove the seeds and ribs.
Place chilis in an oven heated to 350 degrees for one minute.
When the chilis cool, they should be brittle, but the color should not have changed (wear gloves when handling chilies).
Place the chilis in a blender with 1 cup of vegetable stock.
Purée until the chilis are nothing more than little flecks.
Add to the saute.
Break up the dried tortillas with your hands, leaving 1 cup for garnish, and place in the blender with 1 cup of vegetable stock.
Puree until smooth, then add to the saute.
Add the rest of the vegetable stock to the mixture.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 10 minutes.
Puree about half of the soup.
Add the beans and cilantro and heat through.
Garnish with the remaining cup of tortilla strips.
recipes.notes: How to cook beans: Soak beans overnight. Drain and rinse the beans and place in a sauce pot. Cover with three inches of water and bring to a boil over high heat. Add one bay leaf, 1/4 of an onion, 2 sprigs of thyme, 1 tsp peppercorns, and a clove of garlic. Cover the pot, turn down the heat to medium low and simmer the beans gently for 30 to 60 minutes. About 1/2 cup of dry beans makes a little more than 1 cup of cooked.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Tossed Greens, Fennel, and Fruit Salad
recipes.author: Coach Jodi
recipes.description: A tasty combination of fruits and vegetables all packed into one salad!
ingredients: 2 cups honeydew melon, bite sized pieces.
instructions: Put fresh greens in bowl.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Serve with one of our tasty dressings.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Traditional Baba Ganoush Salad
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Blend of eggplant and garbanzo beans with a heaping portion of healthy greens.
ingredients: 4 cups garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Peel and dice eggplant and toss with olive oil, oregano, cumin, and garlic.
Bake in oven for 30-35 minutes or until cooked through.
Heat mushrooms for 1 minute.
Drain garbanzo beans.
Layer greens in container.
Add cherry tomatoes, onions, garbanzo beans, cucumber, mushrooms, and red bell pepper.
Top with baked eggplant.
recipes.notes: This can also be served with a whole wheat pita or stuffed in a wrap.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Ultimate Chocolate Cake
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A fudgey chocolate cake with chocolate nut icing.
ingredients: 1 cup, chunks pineapple, chunks in own juice, drained.
1 cup, whole or halves raw macadamia nut, for icing.
1 cup vanilla soy milk, for icing.
1/3 cup, whole brazil nut, for icing.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, and natural non-alkalized cocoa powder in a large mixing bowl. Set aside.
In a high-speed blender, combine dates, pineapple, ripe banana, unsweetened applesauce, beets, carrots, zucchini, dried currants, walnuts, and vanilla extract. Blend until smooth.
Combine wet ingredients with dry ingredients and mix well, but do not over mix.
Use olive oil to coat a half sheet pan.
Add the cake batter.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until toothpick comes out clean.
To make icing, place all ingredients in a high-speed blender and mix until smooth (or desired texture).
recipes.notes:
This dessert goes great with strawberries. Another healthy alternative is banana "ice cream" topping, made from frozen bananas, non-dairy milk, and vanilla. 
Not suitable for diabetics. Special occasion dessert.
recipes.prepInstructions: Serve cold.

recipes.name: Vanilla Macadamia Cream
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy dip, spread, or icing. Macadamia nuts work wonders as icing when sweetened with dates!
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups whole or halved macadamia nuts, unsalted.
instructions: Blend nuts, non-dairy milk, vanilla extract, and dates together in a high-powered blender.
Serve over preferred fruit.
recipes.notes:
For a different flavor, substitute dried mangoes for half the dates. Soak the dried mangoes in the soy milk overnight.
May also be used as a topping on a fruit sorbet or fruit compote.
For special occasions.
recipes.prepInstructions: serve cold.

recipes.name: Vegetable Lentil Stew
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A hearty stew full of broccoli, lentils, and other tender veggies.
ingredients: 4 cups packaged or canned diced tomatoes, no-salt-added.
1 large sweet potato, peeled and chopped.
instructions: Place the lentils and vegetable stock in a pot.
Cook until lentils are half way cooked (approximately 15 minutes) and add remaining ingredients except cashew butter.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes until lentils are done.
Add cashew butter and stir until blended.
Remove from heat.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Veggie and Wild Rice Stuffed Cabbage
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Not your typical stuffed cabbage - comes with mushrooms, zucchini, bell peppers, wild rice, and onions. Topped with HFN's signature tomato sauce.
ingredients: 1 cup wild rice, cooked follow package instructions.
16 large cabbage leaves, blanched and cooked until tender, see step 2. 2 stuffed cabbage leaves per person.
1/2 cup no-salt-added vegetable stock, for cooking.
1 cup, chopped red bell pepper, 1/4 inch dice.
2 cups mushroom, minced (can be chopped in a food processor).
1 cup loosely packed kale, stems removed and finely chopped.
instructions: To cook cabbage, bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cut out the stem of the head of cabbage and discard.
Place head in the pot of boiling water, the stem-side first, and cover.
Boil for about 10 minutes, until the leaves start to look transparent and break off the cabbage head.
Plunge into a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking.
Pat the leaves dry with a kitchen towel.
For filling: In a wide pan, sauté the onions and garlic in vegetable stock until soft.
Add zucchini, red pepper, kale and some more stock and cook briefly. Vegetables should still be crisp.
Add the dried herb, thyme, basil, marjoram, caraway seeds, and no-salt seasoning. Mix together.
Add the cooked wild rice, raisins, and walnuts.
Stir in 1 cup of tomato sauce and heat through.
Start assembling by spreading 1 cup of HFN tomato sauce on bottom of casserole dish.
Cut out the thick part of each leaf and discard.
Overlap the cut part of the leaf and spoon 1/3 cup of filling in the bottom third of the leaf.
Roll over once, then fold in the sides of the leaf and continue rolling it up.
Use a toothpick to seal it and place it seam-side down in the casserole dish.
Remember to remove the toothpick before serving.
Place cabbage rolls in dish, fitting them tightly. If you need to make a second layer, spread some tomato sauce over the bottom layer of rolls then place a second layer of cabbage rolls over it.
Cover the casserole tightly and bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Veggie Asian Stir Fry
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Fresh veggies and brown rice spiced with sesame, ginger, and red pepper.
ingredients: 1/4 cup no-salt-added vegetable stock, more if needed.
2 lb extra-firm tofu, cubed for marinade.
4 tsp Bragg Liquid Amino, for marinade.
1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, for marinade, or as desired.
1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, for sauce, or as desired.
1/4 cup unhulled sesame seed, for marinade.
1/2 cup natural peanut butter, for sauce, unsalted.
2 large onion, cut into wedges and separated into 1-inch strips.
4 large (7-1/4" to 8-/1/2" long) carrot, cut diagonally into 1/3 inch pieces.
2 large (2-1/4 per pound, approx 3-3/4" long, 3" dia.) red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1 inch strips.
1 cup, chopped sugar snap pea, strings removed or snow peas.
2 cup, shredded bok choy, cut in bite-sized pieces.
1/2 cup all natural apricot preserves, for sauce.
4 tbsp fresh ginger, chopped for sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Squeeze out all of the water in the tofu.
Marinate tofu for 30 minutes in the Liquid Aminos and red pepper flakes.
Toss the tofu often so the marinade gets on all sides.
Toss the marinated tofu with the sesame seeds.
Bake the sesame-coated tofu in a nonstick baking pan for 30 minutes, until golden.
For rice: combine with 4 cups vegetable stock in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer 40 minutes, then set aside uncovered.

For sauce: place the fruit spread, peanut butter, ginger, garlic, no-salt seasoning, vinegar, arrowroot powder, and red pepper flakes in a high-powered blender and blend until smooth. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Saute the onion, carrots, bell peppers, and peas in vegetable stock for 5 minutes, adding more stock as necessary to keep vegetables from scorching.
Add the bok choy, broccoli, and mushrooms. Simmer until the vegetables are tender, and cook off most of the stock.
Add the spinach and toss until wilted.
Add sauce and stir until all vegetables are glazed and the sauce is hot and bubbly, about 1 minute.
Toss in the baked tofu.
Top with chopped peanuts.
Serve with rice.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Veggie Stuffed Peppers with Quinoa
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: Over-stuffed peppers with veggies and Quinoa topped with our HFN Tomato Sauce.
ingredients: 4 large green bell peppers, cut in half (lengthwise), seeds and veins removed.
1 cup, chopped roasted red pepper, diced.
2 cups HFN tomato sauce , reserve 1/2 cup for topping.
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 1/4 cup water to a boil.
Add quinoa, and turn heat to low.
Cover and simmer gently for about 15 minutes, until all the liquid is absorbed.
Set aside, covered.
Steam bell peppers in 1/2 inch boiling water for about 8-10 minutes, until nearly tender.
Heat 1/8 cup water and sauté the garlic, onion, and red pepper.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, mushrooms, and carrots and cook until eggplant and zucchini are soft.
Add the cooked quinoa, 1 cup of pasta sauce, corn, peas, seasonings, and basil.
Spoon vegetable-quinoa mixture into peppers.
Top the peppers with the remaining 1 cup of pasta sauce.
Sprinkle with Dayia non-dairy mozzarella cheese and bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Veggie Tossed Spaghetti Squash
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A healthy, spaghetti-style vegetable (squash) with fresh spices, beans and a burst of tomato flavor.
ingredients: 1 small zucchini, chopped into small pieces.
2 packages (10 oz) pinto beans, rinsed and drained.
2 cups packaged or canned diced tomatoes, drained no-salt-added.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Slice spaghetti squash in half (lengthwise) and remove seeds.
Place both halves upside down on a baking sheet. Bake for 45 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook carrots and celery in 2 tablespoons of water in a covered pan over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add a little more water if needed.
Add garlic, cabbage, and zucchini and cook, covered, for another 10 minutes.
Stir in remaining ingredients, except for pasta sauce.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until carrots are tender.
When squash is done, remove from oven. Using a fork, scrape spaghetti-like strands from squash into a bowl. Add pasta sauce and mix thoroughly.
Add the vegetables, beans, and herbs to the mixture and serve.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Very Veggie Vegetable Soup
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: This vegetable soup is THE BEST EVER!
ingredients: 2 cups diced tomato, canned or fresh (no salt).
2 cups garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed (no salt).
2 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed (no salt).
instructions: Add all ingredients to a large soup pot, except for beans and basil.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until carrots and sweet potatoes are cooked.
Add beans and basil. Mix well.
Turn off heat.
Let sit 10 minutes.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Watermelon Summer Salad
recipes.author: Eugene Pevzner
recipes.description: Healthy and delicious summer salad made from fruits veggies and heart healthy seeds with a twist. It's definitely worth a try.
instructions: Chop tomatoes, cucumber, and watermelon, and then slice strawberries and lettuce.
Mix with dry basil and minced fresh mint leaves.
Mix together with raw sunflower seeds.
Add any preferred seasonings to taste.

recipes.name: Wild Mushrooms over Mashed Cauliflower
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A tasty blend of mushrooms, onions, and cauliflower.
ingredients: 4 lb wild mushrooms, thinly sliced (buttons, crimini, portobella, etc.).
1 tbsp fresh tarragon leaves, chopped (or 2 tbsp of dry tarragon).
1 tbsp arrowroot powder, or tapioca flour.
instructions: In a nonstick skillet, water sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add mushrooms and continue cooking until mushrooms soften and lose their moisture.
Add lemon juice, tarragon, and paprika and mix well.
Blend vegetable broth and tahini (heating the broth makes blending easier).
Pour broth over mushroom mixture and mix well. Simmer until mixture thickens slightly or until desired consistency.
Make a slurry with arrowroot powder and vegetable broth. Add to sauce and cook until thickened.
To make mashed cauliflower, steam cauliflower until tender. Add to high speed food processor with no-salt seasoning. Blend until smooth.
Serve mushrooms over smashed steamed cauliflower.
recipes.prepInstructions: Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.

recipes.name: Zesty Chicken with Steamed Kale
recipes.author: Healthy Food Now
recipes.description: A delicious blend of kale and chicken with the perfect touch of citrus flavor.
ingredients: 2 cooked organic chicken breasts, skinless and boneless (cut into 4 oz servings).
2 bunches kale, tough stems removed, center ribs removed, and leaves chopped .
instructions: Add carrot juice, no-salt seasoning, liquid aminos, garlic, lemon zest, ginger, carrots and red pepper to pan, simmer on high heat for 5-7 minutes to reduce sauce and until vegetables are tender.
Mix arrowroot with vegetable stock and add to simmering sauce. Continue cooking until sauce thickens, about 2 minutes.
Add chicken to sauce and simmer for 5 minutes with lid on top to steam chicken in flavorful sauce.
Add kale and cook for 5 minutes. Add a pinch of cayenne.
recipes.prepInstructions: Remove lid. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes on high, more if needed.
